118.py: Tā zài yī jiā ruǎn jiàn gōng sī zhǎo dào le yī fèn xīn gōng zuò.
118.en: He found a new job at a software company.

119.zh: 经常运动可以使我们的身体更加健康。
119.py: Jīng cháng yùn dòng kě yǐ shǐ wǒ mén de shēn tǐ gèng jiā jiàn kāng.
119.en: Regular exercise can make our bodies healthier.

120.zh: 遇到紧急情况时一定要保持冷静。
120.py: Yù dào jǐn jí qíng kuàng shí yī dìng yào bǎo chí lěng jìng.
120.en: You must stay calm when encountering an emergency situation.

122.zh: 他的性格非常开朗，很容易与人相处。
122.py: Tā de xìng gé fēi cháng kāi lǎng, hěn róng yì yǔ rén xiāng chǔ.
122.en: His personality is very cheerful, and he gets along easily with people.

123.zh: 我不知道去火车站最快的方法是什么。
123.py: Wǒ bù zhī dào qù huǒ chē zhàn zuì kuài de fāng fǎ shì shén me.
123.en: I do not know what is the fastest way to get to the train station.

124.zh: 过马路时请走人行横道，注意交通安全。
124.py: Guò mǎ lù shí qǐng zǒu rén xíng héng dào, zhù yì jiāo tōng ān quán.
124.en: When crossing the road please use the crosswalk and pay attention to traffic safety.

125.zh: 他在大学里学习了三年中文。
125.py: Tā zài dà xué lǐ xué xí le sān nián zhōng wén.
125.en: He studied Chinese for three years in university.

126.zh: 外面又下起了大雨，出门记得带伞。
126.py: Wài miàn yòu xià qǐ le dà yǔ, chū mén jì dé dài sǎn.
126.en: It started raining heavily outside again, remember to bring an umbrella when going out.

127.zh: 睡觉之前别忘了把窗户关好。
127.py: Shuì jiào zhī qián bié wàng le bǎ chuāng hù guān hǎo.
127.en: Do not forget to close the windows properly before going to sleep.

128.py: Wǒ mén yuē hǎo jīn tiān xià wǔ sān diǎn zài kā fēi guǎn jiàn miàn.
128.en: We arranged to meet at the coffee shop at three o'clock this afternoon.

129.py: Wǒ gāng cái zhèng zhǔn bèi chū mén, nǐ jiù dǎ diàn huà lái le.
129.en: I was just about to go out when you called.

130.zh: 老师要求大家明天按时提交作业。
130.py: Lǎo shī yāo qiú dà jiā míng tiān àn shí tí jiāo zuò yè.
130.en: The teacher requires everyone to submit their homework on time tomorrow.

131.en: Learning a foreign language requires long-term persistence and practice.

132.en: The newly built library will officially open to the public next week.

133.zh: 我打算在这个周末读完这两本书。
133.py: Wǒ dǎ suàn zài zhè gè zhōu mò dú wán zhè liǎng běn shū.
133.en: I plan to finish reading these two books over the weekend.

134.zh: 他的汉语水平提高了很多。
134.py: Tā de hàn yǔ shuǐ píng tí gāo le hěn duō.
134.en: His Chinese proficiency has improved a lot.

135.zh: 我们每天都要合理安排好自己的学习时间。
135.py: Wǒ mén měi tiān dōu yào hé lǐ ān pái hǎo zì jǐ de xué xí shí jiān.
135.en: We need to reasonably arrange our study time every day.

136.py: Yóu yú jīn tiān lù shàng dǔ chē, tā chí dào le shí wǔ fēn zhōng.
136.en: Due to traffic congestion on the road today, he was fifteen minutes late.

137.zh: 如果你在学习中遇到问题，可以随时问我。
137.py: Rú guǒ nǐ zài xué xí zhōng yù dào wèn tí, kě yǐ suí shí wèn wǒ.
137.en: If you encounter problems in your studies, you can ask me anytime.

138.zh: 这家餐厅的菜味道很不错，价格也很便宜。
138.py: Zhè jiā cān tīng de cài wèi dào hěn bù cuò, jià gé yě hěn pián yí.
138.en: The food at this restaurant tastes very good, and the price is also very cheap.

139.zh: 跑步是我最喜欢的日常运动方式之一。
139.py: Pǎo bù shì wǒ zuì xǐ huān de rì cháng yùn dòng fāng shì zhī yī.
139.en: Running is one of my favorite daily forms of exercise.

140.py: Shēn tǐ jiàn kāng shì shēng huó zhōng zuì zhòng yào de shì qíng.
140.en: Good health is the most important thing in life.

141.zh: 这个问题并没有大家想象的那么复杂。
141.py: Zhè gè wèn tí bìng méi yǒu dà jiā xiǎng xiàng de nà me fù zá.
141.en: This problem is actually not as complicated as everyone imagined.

142.zh: 公园里生活着很多可爱的小动物。
142.py: Gōng yuán lǐ shēng huó zhe hěn duō kě ài de xiǎo dòng wù.
142.en: Many cute small animals live in the park.

143.zh: 饭前洗手是一个非常良好的卫生习惯。
143.py: Fàn qián xǐ shǒu shì yī gè fēi cháng liáng hǎo de wèi shēng xí guàn.
143.en: Washing hands before meals is a very good hygiene habit.

144.zh: 我们应该养成每天按时睡觉的好习惯。
144.py: Wǒ mén yīng gāi yǎng chéng měi tiān àn shí shuì jiào de hǎo xí guàn.
144.en: We should develop the good habit of going to sleep on time every day.

145.zh: 面对新的挑战，我们要充满信心。
145.py: Miàn duì xīn de tiǎo zhàn, wǒ mén yào chōng mǎn xìn xīn.
145.en: Facing new challenges, we need to be full of confidence.

146.py: Tā wēi xiào zhe xiàng zǒu guò lái de péng yǒu zhāo shǒu zhì yì.
146.en: He smiled and waved in greeting toward the approaching friend.

147.zh: 走路的时候不要一直低头看手机。
147.py: Zǒu lù de shí hòu bù yào yī zhí dī tóu kàn shǒu jī.
147.en: Do not keep your head down looking at your phone while walking.

148.py: Tā duì zhōng guó yōu jiǔ de chuán tǒng wén huà fēi cháng gǎn xìng qù.
148.en: He is very interested in China's long-standing traditional culture.

149.zh: 充足的睡眠对保持身体健康非常关键。
149.py: Chōng zú de shuì mián duì bǎo chí shēn tǐ jiàn kāng fēi cháng guān jiàn.
149.en: Adequate sleep is very crucial for maintaining good health.

150.zh: 政府公布了新的环保政策。
150.py: Zhèng fǔ gōng bù le xīn de huán bǎo zhèng cè.
150.en: The government announced new environmental policies.

151.py: Xī hú de zì rán fēng jǐng fēi cháng měi lì mí rén.
151.en: The natural scenery of West Lake is very beautiful and charming.

152.zh: 他们两个人互相信任，互相支持。
152.py: Tā men liǎng gè rén hù xiāng xìn rèn, hù xiāng zhī chí.
152.en: The two of them trust each other and support each other.

153.zh: 很高兴今天能在这里见到你。
153.py: Hěn gāo xìng jīn tiān néng zài zhè lǐ jiàn dào nǐ.
153.en: I am very glad to meet you here today.

154.py: Wǒ de zì xíng chē bèi dì di jiè zǒu le.
154.en: My bicycle was borrowed by my younger brother.

155.zh: 多吃蔬菜对我们的身体健康很有利。
155.py: Duō chī shū cài duì wǒ men de shēn tǐ jiàn kāng hěn yǒu lì.
155.en: Eating more vegetables is very beneficial to our health.

156.py: Nǐ xiǎng hē diǎn ér shén me yǐn liào?
156.en: What kind of beverage would you like to drink?

157.zh: 教室里一共有二十二名学生。
157.py: Jiào shì lǐ yī gòng yǒu èr shí èr míng xué shēng.
157.en: There are twenty-two students in total in the classroom.

158.en: Please wait a moment here, the doctor will come right away.

159.py: Zhè jiā gōng chǎng zhǔ yào shēng chǎn gāo pǐn zhì dì diàn zi chǎn pǐn.
159.en: This factory mainly produces high-quality electronic products.

160.zh: 你可以选择喝茶或者喝咖啡。
160.py: Nǐ kě yǐ xuǎn zé hē chá huò zhě hē kā fēi.
160.en: You can choose to drink tea or coffee.

161.zh: 新学期开始了，我们迎来了很多新同学。
161.py: Xīn xué qī kāi shǐ le, wǒ men yíng lái le hěn duō xīn tóng xué.
161.en: The new semester has begun, and we welcomed many new classmates.

162.zh: 每个人都应该学会照顾好自己。
162.py: Měi gè rén dōu yīng gāi xué huì zhào gù hǎo zì jǐ.
162.en: Everyone should learn to take good care of themselves.

163.py: Xué xiào zhì dìng le xiáng xì de tú shū jiè yuè zhì dù.
163.en: The school formulated a detailed library borrowing system.

164.zh: 每天坚持锻炼身体能增强体质。
164.py: Měi tiān jiān chí duàn liàn shēn tǐ néng zēng qiáng tǐ zhì.
164.en: Insisting on exercising your body every day can strengthen your constitution.

165.py: Rú guǒ míng tiān xià yǔ, wǒ men jiù tuī chí yùn dòng huì.
165.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will postpone the sports meet.

166.zh: 多参加户外活动可以增加生活乐趣。
166.py: Duō cān jiā hù wài huó dòng kě yǐ zēng jiā shēng huó lè qù.
166.en: Participating in outdoor activities more can add joy to life.

167.zh: 太阳从东方升起，从西方落下。
167.py: Tài yáng cóng dōng fāng shēng qǐ, cóng xī fāng là xià.
167.en: The sun rises from the east and sets in the west.

168.py: É luó sī shì shì jiè shàng guó tǔ miàn jī zuì dà de guó jiā.
168.en: Russia is the country with the largest land area in the world.

169.zh: 中秋节的月亮又大又圆。
169.py: Zhōng qiū jié de yuè liàng yòu dà yòu yuán.
169.en: The moon on the Mid-Autumn Festival is both big and round.

170.zh: 请你说实话，不要隐瞒事实。
170.py: Qǐng nǐ shuō shí huà, bú yào yǐn mán shì shí.
170.en: Please tell the truth and do not conceal facts.

171.zh: 这件白色的衬衫非常适合你。
171.py: Zhè jiàn bái sè de chèn shān fēi cháng shì hé nǐ.
171.en: This white shirt suits you very well.

172.zh: 下班回家后，他喜欢听听轻松的音乐。
172.py: Xià bān huí jiā hòu, tā xǐ huān tīng tīng qīng sōng de yīn yuè.
172.en: After returning home from work, he likes listening to relaxing music.

173.zh: 这道菜的味道非常特别，我很喜欢。
173.py: Zhè dào cài de wèi dào fēi cháng tè bié, wǒ hěn xǐ huān.
173.en: The taste of this dish is very special, I like it a lot.

174.zh: 智能手机代表了现代通信技术的发展。
174.py: Zhì néng shǒu jī dài biǎo le xiàn dài tōng xìn jì shù de fā zhǎn.
174.en: Smartphones represent the development of modern communication technology.

175.zh: 请在三十分钟内完成这份试卷。
175.py: Qǐng zài sān shí fēn zhōng nèi wán chéng zhè fèn shì juàn.
175.en: Please complete this exam paper within thirty minutes.

176.zh: 我相信通过努力一定能实现梦想。
176.py: Wǒ xiāng xìn tōng guò nǔ lì yí dìng néng shí xiàn mèng xiǎng.
176.en: I believe that through hard work one can definitely achieve one's dreams.

177.zh: 他用微笑表达了对大家的谢意。
177.py: Tā yòng wēi xiào biǎo dá le duì dà jiā de xiè yì.
177.en: He expressed his gratitude to everyone with a smile.

178.zh: 随着科技发展，城市发生了巨大的变化。
178.py: Suí zhe kē jì fā zhǎn, chéng shì fā shēng le jù dà de biàn huà.
178.en: With the development of technology, tremendous changes have taken place in the city.

179.zh: 王老师有着丰富的教学经验。
179.py: Wáng lǎo shī yǒu zhe fēng fù de jiào xué jīng yàn.
179.en: Teacher Wang has rich teaching experience.

180.zh: 朋友送给我一本很有趣的小说。
180.py: Péng yǒu sòng gěi wǒ yī běn hěn yǒu qù de xiǎo shuō.
180.en: A friend gave me a very interesting novel.

181.zh: 他梦想着将来能周游世界各地。
181.py: Tā mèng xiǎng zhe jiāng lái néng zhōu yóu shì jiè gè dì.
181.en: He dreams of traveling around the world in the future.

182.zh: 请大家在自己的座位上坐好。
182.py: Qǐng dà jiā zài zì jǐ de zuò wèi shàng zuò hǎo.
182.en: Please everyone sit properly in your own seats.

183.zh: 这是我第一次乘坐高铁去旅行。
183.py: Zhè shì wǒ dì yī cì chéng zuò gāo tiě qù lǚ xíng.
183.en: This is my first time taking the high-speed train to travel.

184.zh: 今天北京的最高气温达到了三十度。
184.py: Jīn tiān běi jīng de zuì gāo qì wēn dá dào le sān shí dù.
184.en: Today's highest temperature in Beijing reached thirty degrees.

185.zh: 出门前请检查门窗是否关好。
185.py: Chū mén qián qǐng jiǎn chá mén chuāng shì fǒu guān hǎo.
185.en: Please check whether the doors and windows are closed before leaving home.

186.zh: 无论遇到什么任务，他都认真负责。
186.py: Wú lùn yù dào shén me rèn wù, tā dōu rèn zhēn fù zé.
186.en: No matter what task he encounters, he is conscientious and responsible.

187.zh: 我们经常在周末一起去图书馆看书。
187.py: Wǒ men jīng cháng zài zhōu mò yì qǐ qù tú shū guǎn kàn shū.
187.en: We often go to the library together to read on weekends.

188.zh: 进门之前请先敲门以示礼貌。
188.py: Jìn mén zhī qián qǐng xiān qiāo mén yǐ shì lǐ mào.
188.en: Please knock on the door first before entering as a courtesy.

189.zh: 夏天很多人喜欢去海边游泳度假。
189.py: Xià tiān hěn duō rén xǐ huān qù hǎi biān yóu yǒng dù jià.
189.en: In summer, many people like to go swimming and vacation at the seaside.

190.zh: 手机让人们之间的沟通变得非常方便。
190.py: Shǒu jī ràng rén men zhī jiān de gōu tōng biàn de fēi cháng fāng biàn.
190.en: Mobile phones have made communication between people very convenient.

191.zh: 李老师在大学里教授中国历史课程。
191.py: Lǐ lǎo shī zài dà xué lǐ jiào shòu zhōng guó lì shǐ kè chéng.
191.en: Teacher Li teaches Chinese history courses at the university.

192.py: Nà ge kě ài de xiǎo nǚ hái shì tā de nǚ ér.
192.en: That cute little girl is his daughter.

193.zh: 你能告诉我今天迟到的原因吗？
193.py: Nǐ néng gào sù wǒ jīn tiān chí dào de yuán yīn ma?
193.en: Can you tell me the reason why you were late today?

194.py: Wǒ jiā dōng biān yǒu yī zuò měi lì de gōng yuán.
194.en: There is a beautiful park to the east of my home.

195.zh: 清晨树林里传来了清脆的鸟叫声。
195.py: Qīng chén shù lín lǐ chuán lái le qīng cuì de niǎo jiào shēng.
195.en: In early morning, crisp birdsong came from the woods.

196.zh: 如果你有疑问，可以随时举手提问。

196.en: If you have questions, you can raise your hand to ask anytime.

198.en: Please submit the report and relevant materials on time.

199.py: Jīn nián de xī guā bǐ qù nián de gèng tián gèng hǎo chī.
199.en: This year's watermelon is sweeter and tastier than last year's.

200.zh: 图书馆的工作人员非常热心负责。
200.py: Tú shū guǎn de gōng zuò rén yuán fēi cháng rè xīn fù zé.
200.en: The library staff members are very enthusiastic and responsible.

201.zh: 通过这次交流，我们加深了相互了解。
201.py: Tōng guò zhè cì jiāo liú, wǒ men jiā shēn le xiāng hù liǎo jiě.
201.en: Through this exchange, we deepened our mutual understanding.

202.py: Yùn dòng zhī hòu jì de duō bǔ chōng shuǐ fèn.
202.en: Remember to drink more water after exercising.

204.en: This painting is drawn really vividly, just like real life.

205.py: Dà jiā zài huì yì shàng rè liè tǎo lùn le xīn de fāng àn.
205.en: Everyone enthusiastically discussed the new proposal at the meeting.

206.en: Everywhere in life there are places worth learning from.

207.py: Wǎn fàn hòu zài xiǎo gōng yuán lǐ sàn bù zǒu zǒu hěn shū fú.
207.en: Walking and strolling in the small park after dinner is very comfortable.

208.en: Protecting the environment is of great significance to humanity's future.

297.en: Every citizen enjoys legal rights granted by law.

298.zh: 遇到复杂问题时，我们需要多角度思考。
298.py: Yù dào fù zá wèn tí shí, wǒ men xū yào duō jiǎo dù sī kǎo.
298.en: When encountering complex problems, we need to think from multiple perspectives.

299.zh: 狮子被人们称为森林之王。
299.py: Shī zi bèi rén men chēng wéi sēn lín zhī wáng.
299.en: The lion is known by people as the king of the forest.

300.zh: 大象是陆地上体型最大的哺乳动物。
300.py: Dà xiàng shì lù dì shàng tǐ xíng zuì dà de bǔ rǔ dòng wù.
300.en: The elephant is the largest land mammal.

301.zh: 他在规定时间内按时完成了所有工作。
301.py: Tā zài guī dìng shí jiān nèi àn shí wán chéng le suǒ yǒu gōng zuò.
301.en: He completed all the work on time within the specified period.

302.zh: 这位年轻的设计师设计了许多漂亮的服装。
302.py: Zhè wèi nián qīng de shè jì shī shè jì le xǔ duō piào liàng de fú zhuāng.
302.en: This young designer designed many beautiful garments.

303.zh: 现代社会有许多种不同的学习方式。
303.py: Xiàn dài shè huì yǒu xǔ duō zhǒng bù tóng de xué xí fāng shì.
303.en: There are many different learning styles in modern society.

304.zh: 公园里盛开着五颜六色的花朵。
304.py: Gōng yuán lǐ shèng kāi zhe wǔ yán liù sè de huā duǒ.
304.en: Colorful flowers are blooming in the park.

305.zh: 回家的路上有一条美丽的林荫小道。
305.py: Huí jiā de lù shàng yǒu yī tiáo měi lì de lín yīn xiǎo dào.
305.en: On the way home there is a beautiful tree-lined path.

306.zh: 请在笔记本上认真记录老师讲的要点。
306.py: Qǐng zài bǐ jì běn shàng rèn zhēn jì lù lǎo shī jiǎng de yào diǎn.
306.en: Please carefully take notes in your notebook on key points taught by the teacher.

307.zh: 候鸟在秋天会飞往温暖的南方过冬。
307.py: Hòu niǎo zài qiū tiān huì fēi wǎng wēn nuǎn de nán fāng guò dōng.
307.en: Migratory birds fly to the warm south in autumn to spend the winter.

308.zh: 这家商店出售各种精美的手工艺品。
308.py: Zhè jiā shāng diàn chū shòu gè zhǒng jīng měi de shǒu gōng yì pǐn.
308.en: This shop sells various exquisite handicrafts.

309.zh: 他在这个安静的街区居住了很多年。
309.py: Tā zài zhè ge ān jìng de jiē qū jū zhù le hěn duō nián.
309.en: He has lived in this quiet neighborhood for many years.

310.zh: 经理在会议上宣布了最新的业务报告。
310.py: Jīng lǐ zài huì yì shàng xuān bù le zuì xīn de yè wù bào gào.
310.en: The manager announced the latest business report at the meeting.

311.zh: 人类应该与大自然中的各种动物和谐相处。
311.py: Rén lèi yīng gāi yǔ dà zì rán zhōng de gè zhǒng dòng wù hé xié xiāng chǔ.
311.en: Humanity should live in harmony with various animals in nature.

312.zh: 我们要勇于追求自己的梦想与目标。
312.py: Wǒ men yào yǒng yú zhuī qiú zì jǐ de mèng xiǎng yǔ mù biāo.
312.en: We must be brave in pursuing our dreams and goals.

313.zh: 根据天气预报，明天可能会有雷阵雨。
313.py: Gēn jù tiān qì yù bào, míng tiān kě néng huì yǒu léi zhèn yǔ.
313.en: According to the weather forecast, there may be thundershowers tomorrow.

314.zh: 经过艰苦的工程建设，新大桥顺利通车。
314.py: Jīng guò jiān kǔ de gōng chéng jiàn shè, xīn dà qiáo shùn lì tōng chē.
314.en: After arduous engineering construction, the new bridge opened to traffic smoothly.

315.zh: 北京是中国的政治和文化交流中心。
315.py: Běi jīng shì zhōng guó de zhèng zhì hé wén huà jiāo liú zhōng xīn.
315.en: Beijing is China's center for political and cultural exchanges.

316.zh: 湖边有一片郁郁葱葱的树林。
316.py: Hú biān yǒu yī piàn yù yù cōng cōng de shù lín.
316.en: Beside the lake there is a lush green forest.

317.zh: 他很勇敢，一点儿也不怕死。
317.py: Tā hěn yǒng gǎn, yì diǎn ér yě bù pà sǐ.
317.en: He is very brave and is not afraid of death at all.

318.zh: 请大家准备一张干净的白纸来画画。
318.py: Qǐng dà jiā zhǔn bèi yī zhāng gān jìng de bái zhǐ lái huà huà.
318.en: Please everyone prepare a clean sheet of white paper for drawing.

319.zh: 遇到不懂的问题，你应该主动请教老师。
319.py: Yù dào bù dǒng de wèn tí, nǐ yīng gāi zhǔ dòng qǐng jiào lǎo shī.
319.en: When encountering problems you do not understand, you should take initiative to ask the teacher.

320.zh: 语言是人们相互交流思想的重要工具。
320.py: Yǔ yán shì rén men xiāng hù jiāo liú sī xiǎng de zhòng yào gōng jù.
320.en: Language is an important tool for people to exchange thoughts with each other.

321.zh: 学校制定了明确的课堂纪律规定。
321.py: Xué xiào zhì dìng le míng què de kè táng jì lǜ guī dìng.
321.en: The school formulated clear classroom discipline regulations.

322.zh: 长城有上万里的长度，气势宏伟。
322.py: Cháng chéng yǒu shàng wàn lǐ de cháng dù, qì shì hóng wěi.
322.en: The Great Wall is tens of thousands of li in length, with grand momentum.

323.zh: 经过不懈努力，他取得了优异的考试成绩。
323.py: Jīng guò bù xiè nǔ lì, tā qǔ dé le yōu yì de kǎo shì chéng jì.
323.en: Through unremitting efforts, he achieved excellent exam results.

324.zh: 他伸出手，轻轻拉开了厚重的木门。
324.py: Tā shēn chū shǒu, qīng qīng lā kāi le hòu zhòng de mù mén.
324.en: He reached out his hand and gently pulled open the heavy wooden door.

325.zh: 这家书店的装潢风格非常典雅舒适。
325.py: Zhè jiā shū diàn de zhuāng huáng fēng gé fēi cháng diǎn yǎ shū shì.
325.en: The decoration style of this bookstore is very elegant and comfortable.

326.zh: 站在山顶上，可以远望整座城市的美景。
326.py: Zhàn zài shān dǐng shàng, kě yǐ yuǎn wàng zhěng zuò chéng shì de měi jǐng.
326.en: Standing at the mountain peak, one can look afar at the beautiful scenery of the entire city.

327.zh: 今天睡了个好觉，感觉精神十分充沛。
327.py: Jīn tiān shuì le gè hǎo jué, gǎn jué jīng shén shí fēn chōng pèi.
327.en: I had a good sleep today and feel very energetic.

328.zh: 现代医疗技术的进步挽救了许多生命。
328.py: Xiàn dài yī liáo jì shù de jìn bù wǎn jiù le xǔ duō shēng mìng.
328.en: The advancement of modern medical technology has saved many lives.

329.zh: 优秀的企业领导能够带领团队走向成功。
329.py: Yōu xiù de qǐ yè lǐng dǎo néng gòu dài lǐng tuán duì zǒu xiàng chéng gōng.
329.en: An excellent business leader can guide the team to success.

330.zh: 保护地球生态环境是全人类共同的使命。
330.py: Bǎo hù dì qiú shēng tài huán jìng shì quán rén lèi gòng tóng de shǐ mìng.
330.en: Protecting the Earth's ecological environment is the common mission of all humanity.

331.zh: 出发前请再次确认车票和证件是否带齐。
331.py: Chū fā qián qǐng zài cì què rèn chē piào hé zhèng jiàn shì fǒu dài qí.
331.en: Please confirm again whether tickets and IDs are all brought before departing.

332.zh: 中华传统节日文化代代相传至今。
332.py: Zhōng huá chuán tǒng jié rì wén huà dài dài xiāng chuán zhì jīn.
332.en: Traditional Chinese festival culture has been passed down from generation to generation until today.

333.zh: 李老师总是耐心地指导每一个学生。
333.py: Lǐ lǎo shī zǒng shì nài xīn dì zhǐ dǎo měi yí gè xué shēng.
333.en: Teacher Li always patiently guides every student.

334.zh: 站在观景台上可以俯瞰壮丽的山河。
334.py: Zhàn zài guān jǐng tái shàng kě yǐ fǔ kàn zhuàng lì de shān hé.
334.en: Standing on the observation deck, one can overlook the magnificent mountains and rivers.

335.zh: 山间流淌着清澈见底的泉水。
335.py: Shān jiān liú tǎng zhe qīng chè jiàn dǐ de quán shuǐ.
335.en: Crystal-clear spring water flows among the mountains.

336.zh: 今天下午我们将举行一场精彩的足球比赛。
336.py: Jīn tiān xià wǔ wǒ men jiāng jǔ xíng yī cháng jīng cǎi de zú qiú bǐ sài.
336.en: This afternoon we will hold an exciting soccer match.

337.zh: 妈妈把西瓜切成了许多小块分给大家。
337.py: Mā mā bǎ xī guā qiè chéng le xǔ duō xiǎo kuài fēn gěi dà jiā.
337.en: Mom sliced the watermelon into many small pieces and shared them with everyone.

338.zh: 老爷爷在庭院里种了许多美丽的花草。
338.py: Lǎo yé yé zài tíng yuàn lǐ zhǒng le xǔ duō měi lì de huā cǎo.
338.en: Grandpa planted many beautiful flowers and plants in the courtyard.

339.zh: 阅读优秀的书籍能让人受益匪浅。
339.py: Yuè dú yōu xiù de shū jí néng ràng rén shòu yì fěi qiǎn.
339.en: Reading excellent books can make people benefit greatly.

340.zh: 多读书可以增长我们的见识与智慧。
340.py: Duō dú shū kě yǐ zēng zhǎng wǒ men de jiàn shí yǔ zhì huì.
340.en: Reading more books can broaden our knowledge and wisdom.

341.zh: 秋天的时候，山上的枫叶都变红了。
341.py: Qiū tiān de shí hòu, shān shàng de fēng yè dōu biàn hóng le.
341.en: In autumn, the maple leaves on the mountain all turn red.

342.zh: 出门旅行记得随身带好雨具和常用药品。
342.py: Chū mén lǚ xíng jì de suí shēn dài hǎo yǔ jù hé cháng yòng yào pǐn.
342.en: Remember to bring rain gear and common medicine with you when traveling.

343.zh: 热心的导游带领大家参观了历史博物馆。
343.py: Rè xīn de dǎo yóu dài lǐng dà jiā cān guān le lì shǐ bó wù guǎn.
343.en: The enthusiastic tour guide led everyone to visit the history museum.

344.zh: 我们要珍惜时间，争取取得更大的进步。
344.py: Wǒ men yào zhēn xī shí jiān, zhēng qǔ qǔ dé gèng dà de jìn bù.
344.en: We must cherish time and strive to make greater progress.

345.zh: 运动不仅能强身健体，还能愉悦心情。
345.py: Yùn dòng bù jǐn néng qiáng shēn jiàn tǐ, hái néng yú yuè xīn qíng.
345.en: Exercise can not only strengthen the body, but also delight the mood.

346.zh: 他讲的幽默笑话逗得大家哈哈大笑。
346.py: Tā jiǎng de yōu mò xiào huà dòu de dà jiā hā hā dà xiào.
346.en: The humorous joke he told made everyone laugh heartily.

347.zh: 成群的大雁在蓝天中自由自在地飞翔。
347.py: Chéng qún de dà yàn zài lán tiān zhōng zì yóu zì zài dì fēi xiáng.
347.en: Flocks of wild geese fly freely in the blue sky.

348.zh: 微风拂过湖面，荡起了一圈圈波纹。
348.py: Wēi fēng fú guò hú miàn, dàng qǐ le yī quān quān bō wén.
348.en: The gentle breeze brushed the lake surface, causing ripples to spread.

349.zh: 散步是一种非常健康舒适的有氧运动。
349.py: Sàn bù shì yī zhǒng fēi cháng jiàn kāng shū shì de yǒu yǎng yùn dòng.
349.en: Taking a walk is a very healthy and comfortable aerobic exercise.

350.zh: 我们要勇于正视缺点并积极加以改正。
350.py: Wǒ men yào yǒng yú zhèng shì quē diǎn bìng jī jí jiā yǐ gǎi zhèng.
350.en: We must be brave enough to face shortcomings and actively correct them.

351.zh: 秋天是农民伯伯收获粮食的喜悦季节。
351.py: Qiū tiān shì nóng mín bó bo shōu huò liáng shí de xǐ yuè jì jié.
351.en: Autumn is the joyful season when farmers harvest grain.

352.zh: 大树的根深深地扎在肥沃的土壤里。
352.py: Dà shù de gēn shēn shēn dì zhā zài féi wò de tǔ rǎng lǐ.
352.en: The roots of the big tree are deeply embedded in the fertile soil.

353.zh: 保持桌面干净整洁有助于集中注意力。
353.py: Bǎo chí zhuō miàn gān jìng zhěng jié yǒu zhù yú jí zhōng zhù yì lì.
353.en: Keeping the desk clean and tidy helps with concentration.

354.zh: 中国古代人民创造了灿烂辉煌的文明。
354.py: Zhōng guó gǔ dài rén mín chuàng zào le càn làn huī huáng de wén míng.
354.en: The ancient Chinese people created a splendid and brilliant civilization.

355.zh: 学习一门新的语言需要经常开口练习。
355.py: Xué xí yī mén xīn de yǔ yán xū yào jīng cháng kāi kǒu liàn xí.
355.en: Learning a new language requires frequent practice speaking.

356.zh: 互联网把世界各地的人们紧密联系在一起。
356.py: Hù lián wǎng bǎ shì jiè gè dì de rén men jǐn mì lián xì zài yì qǐ.
356.en: The internet connects people from all over the world closely together.

357.zh: 坚持每天运动对身体有好处。
357.py: Jiān chí měi tiān yùn dòng duì shēn tǐ yǒu hǎo chù.
357.en: Persisting in exercising every day is good for health.

358.zh: 老师把全班同学分成了五个学习小组。
358.py: Lǎo shī bǎ quán bān tóng xué fēn chéng le wǔ gè xué xí xiǎo zǔ.
358.en: The teacher divided the whole class into five study groups.

359.zh: 他每天早晨都会坚持去公园晨跑半小时。
359.py: Tā měi tiān zǎo chén dū huì jiān chí qù gōng yuán chén pǎo bàn xiǎo shí.
359.en: He insists on going to the park for a morning run for half an hour every morning.

360.zh: 现代经济的快速发展改善了人民的生活。
360.py: Xiàn dài jīng jì de kuài sù fā zhǎn gǎi shàn le rén mín de shēng huó.
360.en: The rapid development of the modern economy has improved people's lives.

361.zh: 骑自行车上下班既环保又能锻炼身体。
361.py: Qí zì xíng chē shàng xià bān jì huán bǎo yòu néng duàn liàn shēn tǐ.
361.en: Riding a bicycle to and from work is both environmentally friendly and exercises the body.

362.zh: 周末他回到老家探望亲爱的父母。
362.py: Zhōu mò tā huí dào lǎo jiā tàn wàng qīn ài de fù mǔ.
362.en: On the weekend he returned to his hometown to visit his dear parents.

363.zh: 他对待学习的态度非常积极。
363.py: Tā duì dài xué xí de tài dù fēi cháng jī jí.
363.en: His attitude toward learning is very positive.

364.zh: 森林是大自然的绿色宝库和天然氧吧。
364.py: Sēn lín shì dà zì rán de lǜ sè bǎo kù hé tiān rán yǎng bā.
364.en: The forest is nature's green treasure house and natural oxygen bar.

365.zh: 穿上这件保暖的冬装，感觉非常舒服。
365.py: Chuān shàng zhè jiàn bǎo nuǎn de dōng zhuāng, gǎn jué fēi cháng shū fú.
365.en: Putting on this warm winter coat feels very comfortable.

366.zh: 我们要抓紧时间，争取尽快完成任务。
366.py: Wǒ men yào zhuā jǐn shí jiān, zhēng qǔ jǐn kuài wán chéng rèn wù.
366.en: We need to seize the time and strive to complete the task as quickly as possible.

367.zh: 请问去哪里可以办理公共交通卡？
367.py: Qǐng wèn qù nǎ lǐ kě yǐ bàn lǐ gōng gòng jiāo tōng kǎ?
367.en: Excuse me, where can I apply for a public transit card?

368.zh: 大家在会议上就新方案提出了建设性意见。
368.py: Dà jiā zài huì yì shàng jiù xīn fāng àn tí chū le jiàn shè xìng yì jiàn.
368.en: Everyone put forward constructive opinions on the new proposal at the meeting.

369.zh: 列车正向着风景优美的南方平稳开往。
369.py: Liè chē zhèng xiàng zhe fēng jǐng yōu měi de nán fāng píng wěn kāi wǎng.
369.en: The train is steadily heading towards the scenic south.

370.zh: 这套精美的图书总共需要八十元。
370.py: Zhè tào jīng měi de tú shū zǒng gòng xū yào bā shí yuán.
370.en: This set of exquisite books costs eighty yuan in total.

371.zh: 他从小就开始认真学习英语和汉语。
371.py: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù kāi shǐ rèn zhēn xué xí yīng yǔ hé hàn yǔ.
371.en: He began studying English and Chinese earnestly from childhood.

372.zh: 那位年轻战士非常勇敢。
372.py: Nà wèi nián qīng zhàn shì fēi cháng yǒng gǎn.
372.en: That young soldier is very brave.

373.zh: 出门乘车时请随身携带好有效身份证件。
373.py: Chū mén chéng chē shí qǐng suí shēn xié dài hǎo yǒu xiào shēn fèn zhèng jiàn.
373.en: Please carry valid ID credentials with you when traveling by vehicle.

374.zh: 最近天气渐渐变暖，春天的脚步近了。
374.py: Zuì jìn tiān qì jiàn jiàn biàn nuǎn, chūn tiān de jiǎo bù jìn le.
374.en: Recently the weather has gradually warmed up, and the footsteps of spring are near.

375.zh: 面对失败不要气馁，失败是成功之母。
375.py: Miàn duì shī bài bú yào qì něi, shī bài shì chéng gōng zhī mǔ.
375.en: Do not be discouraged in the face of failure; failure is the mother of success.

376.zh: 在下一个十字路口向右转，就能看到医院。
376.py: Zài xià yí gè shí zì lù kǒu xiàng yòu zhuǎn, jiù néng kàn dào yī yuàn.
376.en: Turn right at the next intersection, and you can see the hospital.

377.zh: 这对恩爱的夫妻经常一起在公园散步。
377.py: Zhè duì ēn ài de fū qī jīng cháng yì qǐ zài gōng yuán sàn bù.
377.en: This loving husband and wife often take walks together in the park.

378.zh: 秋天满山遍野的金黄落叶令人陶醉。
378.py: Qiū tiān mǎn shān biàn yě de jīn huáng luò yè lìng rén táo zuì.
378.en: The golden fallen leaves all over the mountains in autumn are intoxicating.

379.zh: 出发之前请认真准备好所有随身物品。
379.py: Chū fā zhī qián qǐng rèn zhēn zhǔn bèi hǎo suǒ yǒu suí shēn wù pǐn.
379.en: Please carefully prepare all personal belongings before setting out.

380.zh: 学校在公告栏上发布了最新的放假通知。
380.py: Xué xiào zài gōng gào lán shàng fā bù le zuì xīn de fàng jià tōng zhī.
380.en: The school announced the latest holiday notice on the bulletin board.

381.zh: 新学期的学习生活从今天正式开始了。
381.py: Xīn xué qī de xué xí shēng huó cóng jīn tiān zhèng shì kāi shǐ le.
381.en: The study life of the new semester has officially started today.

382.zh: 请问去最近的地铁站应该怎么走？
382.py: Qǐng wèn qù zuì jìn de dì tiě zhàn yīng gāi zěn me zǒu?
382.en: Excuse me, how should I get to the nearest subway station?

383.zh: 大家都去开会了，你怎么还在这里呢？
383.py: Dà jiā dōu qù kāi huì le, nǐ zěn me hái zài zhè lǐ ne?
383.en: Everyone went to the meeting, why are you still here?

384.zh: 遇到重要文件时，请记得随时保存备份。
384.py: Yù dào zhòng yào wén jiàn shí, qǐng jì de suí shí bǎo cún bèi fèn.
384.en: When handling important files, please remember to save a backup anytime.

385.zh: 我们要用知识和汗水去创造美好的未来。
385.py: Wǒ men yào yòng zhī shí hé hàn shuǐ qù chuàng zào měi hǎo de wèi lái.
385.en: We must use knowledge and sweat to create a beautiful future.

386.zh: 站在高处可以远眺连绵起伏的山峰。
386.py: Zhàn zài gāo chù kě yǐ yuǎn tiào lián mián qǐ fú de shān fēng.
386.en: Standing on high ground, one can look afar at the rolling mountain peaks.

387.zh: 请问这位热心助人的同学叫什么名字？
387.py: Qǐng wèn zhè wèi rè xīn zhù rén de tóng xué jiào shén me míng zì?
387.en: Excuse me, what is the name of this helpful classmate?

388.zh: 演员们在宽敞明亮的舞台上精彩表演。
388.py: Yǎn yuán men zài kuān chǎng míng liàng de wǔ tái shàng jīng cǎi biǎo yǎn.
388.en: The actors performed brilliantly on the spacious and bright stage.

389.zh: 这道数学题的解法其实非常简单明了。
389.py: Zhè dào shù xué tí de xiè fǎ qí shí fēi cháng jiǎn dān míng liǎo.
389.en: The solution method for this math problem is actually very simple and clear.

390.zh: 周末我们一家人去电影院看了一部新电影。
390.py: Zhōu mò wǒ men yī jiā rén qù diàn yǐng yuàn kàn le yī bù xīn diàn yǐng.
390.en: On the weekend our family went to the cinema to watch a new movie.

391.zh: 这套精美的木工工具质量非常优良。
391.py: Zhè tào jīng měi de mù gōng gōng jù zhì liàng fēi cháng yōu liáng.
391.en: The quality of this set of exquisite woodworking tools is very excellent.

392.zh: 罗马是意大利著名的古城。
392.py: Luó mǎ shì yì dà lì zhù míng de gǔ chéng.
392.en: Rome is a famous ancient city in Italy.

393.zh: 他写的汉字笔画工整，非常美观大方。
393.py: Tā xiě de hàn zì bǐ huà gōng zhěng, fēi cháng měi guān dà fāng.
393.en: The Chinese characters he writes have neat strokes and are very aesthetic and elegant.

394.zh: 父母的爱是世界上最无私温暖的情感。
394.py: Fù mǔ de ài shì shì jiè shàng zuì wú sī wēn nuǎn de qíng gǎn.
394.en: Parents' love is the most selfless and warm emotion in the world.

395.zh: 我们要敢于迎击生活中的各种挑战。
395.py: Wǒ men yào gǎn yú yíng jī shēng huó zhōng de gè zhǒng tiǎo zhàn.
395.en: We must dare to face and combat various challenges in life.

396.zh: 清澈的溪水在山谷之间静静地流淌。
396.py: Qīng chè de xī shuǐ zài shān gǔ zhī jiān jìng jìng dì liú tǎng.
396.en: Clear stream water flows quietly between the valleys.

397.zh: 出门旅行前要准备好充足的水和食物。
397.py: Chū mén lǚ xíng qián yào zhǔn bèi hǎo chōng zú de shuǐ hé shí wù.
397.en: Before going on a trip, prepare sufficient water and food.

398.zh: 那些年轻的士兵保卫着祖国的边疆安全。
398.py: Nà xiē nián qīng dī shì bīng bǎo wèi zhe zǔ guó de biān jiāng ān quán.
398.en: Those young soldiers protect the border security of the motherland.

399.zh: 这场连绵的大雨已经连续下了整整三天。
399.py: Zhè chǎng lián mián de dà yǔ yǐ jīng lián xù xià le zhěng zhěng sān tiān.
399.en: This continuous heavy rain has fallen continuously for three whole days.

400.zh: 根据实际情况，我们需要适时调整工作计划。
400.py: Gēn jù shí jì qíng kuàng, wǒ men xū yào shì shí diào zhěng gōng zuò jì huà.
400.en: According to actual conditions, we need to adjust the work plan in a timely manner.

401.zh: 夜深了，城市的街道渐渐安静了下来。
401.py: Yè shēn le, chéng shì de jiē dào jiàn jiàn ān jìng le xià lái.
401.en: The night grew deep, and the city streets gradually quieted down.

402.zh: 周末这条繁华的商业街上挤满了顾客。
402.py: Zhōu mò zhè tiáo fán huá de shāng yè jiē shàng jǐ mǎn le gù kè.
402.en: On weekends, this bustling commercial street is crowded with customers.

403.zh: 请你仔细计算一下这道题目的最终答案。
403.py: Qǐng nǐ zǐ xì jì suàn yī xià zhè dào tí mù dì zuì zhōng dá àn.
403.en: Please carefully calculate the final answer of this problem.

404.zh: 这家老字号商店的商品质量一直很好。
404.py: Zhè jiā lǎo zì hào shāng diàn de shāng pǐn zhì liàng yì zhí hěn hǎo.
404.en: The product quality of this time-honored shop has always been very good.

405.zh: 一个团结协作的团队能取得更大的成就。
405.py: Yí gè tuán jié xié zuò de tuán duì néng qǔ dé gèng dà de chéng jiù.
405.en: A united and collaborative team can achieve greater accomplishments.

406.zh: 同学们在操场上整齐地集合准备做操。
406.py: Tóng xué men zài cāo chǎng shàng zhěng qí dì jí hé zhǔn bèi zuò cāo.
406.en: Classmates gathered neatly on the sports field ready to do exercises.

407.zh: 这家百年老店保留了许多传统的美食风味。
407.py: Zhè jiā bǎi nián lǎo diàn bǎo liú le xǔ duō chuán tǒng de měi shí fēng wèi.
407.en: This century-old shop retains many traditional food flavors.

408.zh: 人体每天都需要摄入足够的水分和营养。
408.py: Rén tǐ měi tiān dōu xū yào shè rù zú gòu de shuǐ fèn hé yíng yǎng.
408.en: The human body needs to ingest sufficient water and nutrition every day.

409.zh: 这家超市里的日常用品价格非常实惠。
409.py: Zhè jiā chāo shì lǐ de rì cháng yòng pǐn jià gé fēi cháng shí huì.
409.en: The prices of daily necessities in this supermarket are very affordable.

410.zh: 春天到了，花园里的各种花朵竞相开放。
410.py: Chūn tiān dào le, huā yuán lǐ de gè zhǒng huā duǒ jìng xiāng kāi fàng.
410.en: Spring has arrived, and various flowers in the garden are blooming competitively.

411.zh: 党员干部应该全心全意为人民服务。
411.py: Dǎng yuán gàn bù yīng gāi quán xīn quán yì wéi rén mín fú wù.
411.en: Party cadres should serve the people wholeheartedly.

412.zh: 漫步在繁华的市中心，感受现代都市的活力。
412.py: Màn bù zài fán huá de shì zhōng xīn, gǎn shòu xiàn dài dū shì de huó lì.
412.en: Strolling in the bustling city center, feel the vitality of the modern metropolis.

413.zh: 这座古老的城市拥有悠久深厚的历史文化。
413.py: Zhè zuò gǔ lǎo de chéng shì yōng yǒu yōu jiǔ shēn hòu de lì shǐ wén huà.
413.en: This ancient city possesses a long and profound history and culture.

414.zh: 溪水冲刷着河床上圆润光滑的鹅卵石。
414.py: Xī shuǐ chōng shuā zhe hé chuáng shàng yuán rùn guāng huá de é luǎn shí.
414.en: The stream water washed over the smooth, round pebbles on the riverbed.

415.zh: 经过一个学期的努力，他的英语升了一级。
415.py: Jīng guò yí gè xué qī de nǔ lì, tā de yīng yǔ shēng le yī jí.
415.en: Through a semester of effort, his English level moved up one grade.

416.zh: 把书架上的书籍整理整齐让人心情舒畅。
416.py: Bǎ shū jià shàng de shū jí zhěng lǐ zhěng qí ràng rén xīn qíng shū chàng.
416.en: Organizing books on the bookshelf neatly makes one feel comfortable.

417.zh: 市政府出台了改善城市公共交通的新举措。
417.py: Shì zhèng fǔ chū tái le gǎi shàn chéng shì gōng gòng jiāo tōng de xīn jǔ cuò.
417.en: The municipal government rolled out new measures to improve urban public transit.

418.zh: 火车站距离这里只有两公里左右的路程。
418.py: Huǒ chē zhàn jù lí zhè lǐ zhǐ yǒu liǎng gōng lǐ zuǒ yòu de lù chéng.
418.en: The train station is only about two kilometers away from here.

419.zh: 遇到紧急情况时，请大家保持冷静不要慌张。
419.py: Yù dào jǐn jí qíng kuàng shí, qǐng dà jiā bǎo chí lěng jìng bú yào huāng zhāng.
419.en: When encountering an emergency situation, please keep calm and do not panic.

420.zh: 亚洲是世界上人口最多的大洲。
420.py: Yà zhōu shì shì jiè shàng rén kǒu zuì duō de dà zhōu.
420.en: Asia is the continent with the largest population in the world.

421.zh: 请大家在进入图书馆后保持安静。
421.py: Qǐng dà jiā zài jìn rù tú shū guǎn hòu bǎo chí ān jìng.
421.en: Please everyone keep quiet after entering the library.

422.zh: 现代农业技术的推广提高了粮食产量。
422.py: Xiàn dài nóng yè jì shù de tuī guǎng tí gāo le liáng shí chǎn liàng.
422.en: The promotion of modern agricultural technology has increased grain output.

423.zh: 北京是一座著名的国际大都市。
423.py: Běi jīng shì yī zuò zhù míng de guó jì dà dū shì.
423.en: Beijing is a famous international metropolis.

424.zh: 我和朋友约好今天下午三点在校门口碰面。
424.py: Wǒ hé péng yǒu yuē hǎo jīn tiān xià wǔ sān diǎn zài xiào mén kǒu pèng miàn.
424.en: I made an appointment with my friend to meet at the school gate at three this afternoon.

425.zh: 红绿灯的指示能保障出行安全。
425.py: Hóng lǜ dēng de zhǐ shì néng bǎo zhàng chū xíng ān quán.
425.en: Traffic light indications can ensure travel safety.

426.zh: 考前认真复习做过的错题是非常好的习惯。
426.py: Kǎo qián rèn zhēn fù xí zuò guò de cuò tí shì fēi cháng hǎo de xí guàn.
426.en: Carefully reviewing previous mistakes before exams is a very good habit.

427.zh: 生病时要注意多休息并按时遵医嘱服药。
427.py: Shēng bìng shí yào zhù yì duō xiū xī bìng àn shí zūn yī zhǔ fú yào.
427.en: When sick, pay attention to resting more and taking medicine per doctor's orders.

428.zh: 工作学习之余，要给眼睛和身体充分的休息。
428.py: Gōng zuò xué xí zhī yú, yào gěi yǎn jīng hé shēn tǐ chōng fèn de xiū xī.
428.en: Beyond work and study, give your eyes and body adequate rest.

429.zh: 科学家们正在深入研究这种新型环保材料。
429.py: Kē xué jiā men zhèng zài shēn rù yán jiū zhè zhǒng xīn xíng huán bǎo cái liào.
429.en: Scientists are conducting in-depth research on this new eco-friendly material.

430.zh: 乘坐地铁五号线可以直接到达火车站。
430.py: Chéng zuò dì tiě wǔ hào xiàn kě yǐ zhí jiē dào dá huǒ chē zhàn.
430.en: Taking subway Line 5 can get you directly to the train station.

431.zh: 这道难题看似复杂，其实掌握方法后很简单。
431.py: Zhè dào nán tí kàn shì fù zá, qí shí zhǎng wò fāng fǎ hòu hěn jiǎn dān.
431.en: This difficult problem seems complex, but is actually simple once you master the method.

432.zh: 作为一名国家政府官员，要时刻为人民服务。
432.py: Zuò wéi yī míng guó jiā zhèng fǔ guān yuán, yào shí kè wéi rén mín fú wù.
432.en: As a government official, one must serve the people at all times.

433.zh: 冬天的夜晚，大家围在温暖的火炉旁聊天。
433.py: Dōng tiān de yè wǎn, dà jiā wéi zài wēn nuǎn de huǒ lú páng liáo tiān.
433.en: On winter nights, everyone gathers around the warm fire stove chatting.

434.zh: 只要不断坚持学习，就一定能取得显著进步。
434.py: Zhǐ yào bù duàn jiān chí xué xí, jiù yí dìng néng qǔ dé xiǎn zhù jìn bù.
434.en: As long as you continuously persist in learning, you can definitely make remarkable progress.

435.zh: 充足的睡眠能让我们第二天保持充沛的精力。
435.py: Chōng zú de shuì mián néng ràng wǒ men dì èr tiān bǎo chí chōng pèi de jīng lì.
435.en: Adequate sleep allows us to maintain abundant energy the next day.

436.zh: 听到好消息，大家的脸上洋溢着满意的笑容。
436.py: Tīng dào hǎo xiāo xī, dà jiā de liǎn shàng yáng yì zhe mǎn yì de xiào róng.
436.en: Hearing the good news, everyone's faces were filled with satisfied smiles.

437.zh: 感谢朋友们在我遇到困难时给予的坚定支持。
437.py: Gǎn xiè péng yǒu men zài wǒ yù dào kùn nán shí jǐ yǔ de jiān dìng zhī chí.
437.en: Thank friends for giving firm support when I encountered difficulties.

438.zh: 长时间看手机对视力不好。
438.py: Zhǎng shí jiān kàn shǒu jī duì shì lì bù hǎo.
438.en: Looking at phones for a long time is not good for eyesight.

439.zh: 听到这个好消息，大家心中的担忧瞬间消失了。
439.py: Tīng dào zhè ge hǎo xiāo xī, dà jiā xīn zhōng de dān yōu shùn jiān xiāo shī le.
439.en: Hearing this good news, the worries in everyone's hearts vanished instantly.

440.zh: 随着练习次数的增多，他的发音越来越标准。
440.py: Suí zhe liàn xí cì shù de zēng duō, tā de fā yīn yuè lái yuè biāo zhǔn.
440.en: With more practice sessions, his pronunciation became more and more standard.

441.zh: 实验室里摆放着各种精密的科学仪器。
441.py: Shí yàn shì lǐ bǎi fàng zhe gè zhǒng jīng mì de kē xué yí qì.
441.en: Various precise scientific instruments are placed in the laboratory.

442.zh: 这篇优秀的学术文章内容非常丰富充实。
442.py: Zhè piān yōu xiù de xué shù wén zhāng nèi róng fēi cháng fēng fù chōng shí.
442.en: The content of this excellent academic article is very rich and substantial.

443.zh: 阳光照耀在碧绿的湖面上，泛起粼粼波光。
443.py: Yáng guāng zhào yào zài bì lǜ de hú miàn shàng, fàn qǐ lín lín bō guāng.
443.en: Sunlight shines on the jade-green lake, rippling with sparkling waves.

444.zh: 过马路时必须遵守交通信号灯的指示。
444.py: Guò mǎ lù shí bì xū zūn shǒu jiāo tōng xìn hào dēng de zhǐ shì.
444.en: When crossing the street, you must obey traffic signal indications.

445.zh: 农历九月初九是中国传统的重阳节。
445.py: Nóng lì jiǔ yuè chū jiǔ shì zhōng guó chuán tǒng de chóng yáng jié.
445.en: The ninth day of the ninth lunar month is China's traditional Double Ninth Festival.

446.zh: 多参加体育活动可以有效增强身体抵抗力。
446.py: Duō cān jiā tǐ yù huó dòng kě yǐ yǒu xiào zēng qiáng shēn tǐ dǐ kàng lì.
446.en: Participating more in sports activities can effectively enhance body resistance.

447.zh: 大学教授带领研究生开展了新的科研项目。
447.py: Dà xué jiào shòu dài lǐng yán jiū shēng kāi zhǎn le xīn de kē yán xiàng mù.
447.en: The university professor led graduate students to launch a new scientific research project.

448.zh: 每天坚持写日记有助于提高语言表达能力。
448.py: Měi tiān jiān chí xiě rì jì yǒu zhù yú tí gāo yǔ yán biǎo dá néng lì.
448.en: Persisting in writing a diary every day helps improve language expression ability.

449.zh: 大熊猫被大家亲切地称为中国的国宝。
449.py: Dà xióng māo bèi dà jiā qīn qiè dì chēng wéi zhōng guó de guó bǎo.
449.en: The giant panda is affectionately called China's national treasure by everyone.

450.zh: 这家新兴的创新企业吸引了许多年轻人才。
450.py: Zhè jiā xīn xīng de chuàng xīn qǐ yè xī yǐn le xǔ duō nián qīng rén cái.
450.en: This emerging innovative enterprise attracted many young talents.

451.zh: 我们学校每天早晨八点准时开始上课。
451.py: Wǒ men xué xiào měi tiān zǎo chén bā diǎn zhǔn shí kāi shǐ shàng kè.
451.en: Our school starts classes promptly at eight o'clock every morning.

452.zh: 只要持之以恒地努力，就一定能够取得成功。
452.py: Zhǐ yào chí zhī yǐ héng dì nǔ lì, jiù yí dìng néng gòu qǔ dé chéng gōng.
452.en: As long as you persevere with effort, you can definitely achieve success.

453.zh: 请问你明天下午有时间一起去图书馆吗？
453.py: Qǐng wèn nǐ míng tiān xià wǔ yǒu shí jiān yì qǐ qù tú shū guǎn ma?
453.en: Excuse me, do you have time to go to the library together tomorrow afternoon?

454.zh: 他把几本常用的笔记本放进了书包里。
454.py: Tā bǎ jǐ běn cháng yòng de bǐ jì běn fàng jìn le shū bāo lǐ.
454.en: He put several commonly used notebooks into his schoolbag.

455.zh: 秋风吹过，金黄色的落叶一片片飘落下来。
455.py: Qiū fēng chuī guò, jīn huáng sè de luò yè yī piàn piàn piāo luò xià lái.
455.en: When the autumn wind blows, golden fallen leaves flutter down piece by piece.

456.zh: 学习历史能够让我们更好地了解世界的发展。
456.py: Xué xí lì shǐ néng gòu ràng wǒ men gèng hǎo dì liǎo jiě shì jiè de fā zhǎn.
456.en: Studying history allows us to better understand the development of the world.

457.zh: 他是我们班的学习委员。
457.py: Tā shì wǒ men bān de xué xí wěi yuán.
457.en: He is the study committee member of our class.

458.zh: 他的汉语水平似乎提高了不少。
458.py: Tā de hàn yǔ shuǐ píng sì hū tí gāo le bù shǎo.
458.en: His Chinese proficiency seems to have improved a lot.

459.zh: 在提交作业之前，请认真仔细检查一遍。
459.py: Zài tí jiāo zuò yè zhī qián, qǐng rèn zhēn zǐ xì jiǎn chá yī biàn.
459.en: Before submitting your homework, please check it through carefully and attentively.

460.zh: 微风轻轻吹拂着湖边翠绿的杨柳枝条。
460.py: Wēi fēng qīng qīng chuī fú zhe hú biān cuì lǜ de yáng liǔ zhī tiáo.
460.en: The gentle breeze lightly brushed the emerald willow branches beside the lake.

461.zh: 熟能生巧，多加练习后这道题目就很容易了。
461.py: Shú néng shēng qiǎo, duō jiā liàn xí hòu zhè dào tí mù jiù hěn róng yì le.
461.en: Practice makes perfect; after practicing more, this problem becomes very easy.

462.zh: 养成早睡早起的好习惯有利于身体健康。
462.py: Yǎng chéng zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ de hǎo xí guàn yǒu lì yú shēn tǐ jiàn kāng.
462.en: Developing the good habit of early to bed and early to rise is beneficial to health.

463.zh: 我曾经去过北京参观过壮丽的故宫博物院。
463.py: Wǒ céng jīng qù guò běi jīng cān guān guò zhuàng lì de gù gōng bó wù yuàn.
463.en: I have visited the magnificent Palace Museum in Beijing before.

464.zh: 除了汉语，他还会说英语。
464.py: Chú le hàn yǔ, tā hái huì shuō yīng yǔ.
464.en: Besides Chinese, he can also speak English.

465.zh: 秋天是农民辛勤耕耘后喜获丰收的季节。
465.py: Qiū tiān shì nóng mín xīn qín gēng yún hòu xǐ huò fēng shōu de jì jié.
465.en: Autumn is the season when farmers reap a bumper harvest after hard farming.

466.zh: 他在书架上认真寻找自己想看的那本小说。
466.py: Tā zài shū jià shàng rèn zhēn xún zhǎo zì jǐ xiǎng kàn de nà běn xiǎo shuō.
466.en: He carefully searched on the bookshelf for that novel he wanted to read.

467.zh: 妈妈把洗干净的衣服整齐地装进了衣柜里。
467.py: Mā mā bǎ xǐ gān jìng de yī fú zhěng qí dì zhuāng jìn le yī guì lǐ.
467.en: Mom neatly packed the washed clothes into the wardrobe.

468.zh: 广场上聚集了许多晨练散步的市民朋友。
468.py: Guǎng chǎng shàng jù jí le xǔ duō chén liàn sàn bù de shì mín péng yǒu.
468.en: Many citizen friends doing morning exercise and walking gathered in the square.

469.zh: 经过这段时间的锻炼，他的体质有了明显改善。
469.py: Jīng guò zhè duàn shí jiān de duàn liàn, tā de tǐ zhì yǒu le míng xiǎn gǎi shàn.
469.en: Through exercise over this period, his physical constitution has improved significantly.

470.zh: 今天天气真好，我们一起去公园散步吧。
470.py: Jīn tiān tiān qì zhēn hǎo, wǒ men yì qǐ qù gōng yuán sàn bù ba.
470.en: The weather is really nice today, let us go for a walk in the park together.

471.zh: 热情好客的阿姨端上了热气腾腾的特色点心。
471.py: Rè qíng hào kè de ā yí duān shàng le rè qì téng téng de tè sè diǎn xīn.
471.en: The hospitable aunt served piping-hot special dim sum.

472.zh: 果园里的李子成熟了，味道酸甜可口。
472.py: Guǒ yuán lǐ de lǐ zi chéng shú le, wèi dào suān tián kě kǒu.
472.en: The plums in the orchard are ripe, tasting sweet and sour and delicious.

473.zh: 制定明确的学习目标能指引我们不断前行。
473.py: Zhì dìng míng què de xué xí mù biāo néng zhǐ yǐn wǒ men bù duàn qián xíng.
473.en: Setting clear learning goals can guide us to keep moving forward.

474.zh: 他们坐在树荫下亲切地交谈着童年的趣事。
474.py: Tā men zuò zài shù yīn xià qīn qiè dì jiāo tán zhe tóng nián de qù shì.
474.en: Sitting under the shade of trees, they chatted warmly about interesting childhood stories.

475.zh: 多吃富含维生素的新鲜水果有益身体健康。
475.py: Duō chī fù hán wéi shēng sù de xīn xiān shuǐ guǒ yǒu yì shēn tǐ jiàn kāng.
475.en: Eating more fresh fruits rich in vitamins is beneficial to body health.

476.zh: 周末去图书馆看书是他最喜欢的休闲方式。
476.py: Zhōu mò qù tú shū guǎn kàn shū shì tā zuì xǐ huān de xiū xián fāng shì.
476.en: Going to the library to read on weekends is his favorite way of leisure.

477.zh: 他常常想念远方的父母。
477.py: Tā cháng cháng xiǎng niàn yuǎn fāng de fù mǔ.
477.en: He often misses his parents far away.

478.zh: 每个星期六下午他都会去参加足球训练。
478.py: Měi gè xīng qī liù xià wǔ tā dū huì qù cān jiā zú qiú xùn liàn.
478.en: Every Saturday afternoon he goes to participate in soccer training.

479.zh: 精彩的魔术表演吸引了台下所有观众的目光。
479.py: Jīng cǎi de mó shù biǎo yǎn xī yǐn le tái xià suǒ yǒu guān zhòng de mù guāng.
479.en: The wonderful magic performance attracted the eyes of all audience members offstage.

480.zh: 中国拥有数千年悠久而灿烂的历史文化。
480.py: Zhōng guó yōng yǒu shù qiān nián yōu jiǔ ér càn làn de lì shǐ wén huà.
480.en: China possesses thousands of years of long and splendid history and culture.

481.zh: 这首优美动听的钢琴曲让人感到宁静放松。
481.py: Zhè shǒu yōu měi dòng tīng de gāng qín qǔ ràng rén gǎn dào níng jìng fàng sōng.
481.en: This beautiful and melodious piano piece makes people feel peaceful and relaxed.

482.zh: 生病时一定要及时去医院看医生并遵医嘱。
482.py: Shēng bìng shí yí dìng yào jí shí qù yī yuàn kàn yī shēng bìng zūn yī zhǔ.
482.en: When ill, be sure to go to the hospital to see a doctor promptly and follow medical advice.

483.zh: 气象局每天都会按时发布准确的天气预报。
483.py: Qì xiàng jú měi tiān dū huì àn shí fā bù zhǔn què de tiān qì yù bào.
483.en: The meteorological bureau publishes accurate weather forecasts on time every day.

484.zh: 正当我们准备出门时，窗外突然下起了大雨。
484.py: Zhèng dāng wǒ men zhǔn bèi chū mén shí, chuāng wài tū rán xià qǐ le dà yǔ.
484.en: Just as we were preparing to go out, it suddenly began raining heavily outside the window.

485.zh: 李老师是研究中国历史的专家。
485.py: Lǐ lǎo shī shì yán jiū zhōng guó lì shǐ de zhuān jiā.
485.en: Teacher Li is an expert in studying Chinese history.

486.zh: 我们要节约资源，决不能铺张浪费粮食。
486.py: Wǒ men yào jié yuē zī yuán, jué bù néng pū zhāng làng fèi liáng shí.
486.en: We must conserve resources and never squander and waste food.

487.zh: 请大家看清自己准考证上的考场和座位号。
487.py: Qǐng dà jiā kàn qīng zì jǐ zhǔn kǎo zhèng shàng de kǎo chǎng hé zuò wèi hào.
487.en: Please everyone check clearly the examination room and seat number on your admission tickets.

488.zh: 只要大家齐心协力，就能尽快克服眼前的困难。
488.py: Zhǐ yào dà jiā qí xīn xié lì, jiù néng jǐn kuài kè fú yǎn qián de kùn nán.
488.en: As long as everyone works together, we can overcome present difficulties as quickly as possible.

489.zh: 除了这个方案，我们还可以尝试另外一种方法。
489.py: Chú le zhè ge fāng àn, wǒ men hái kě yǐ cháng shì lìng wài yī zhǒng fāng fǎ.
489.en: Besides this plan, we can also try another method.

490.zh: 这个周末我们打算全家一起去郊外露营。
490.py: Zhè ge zhōu mò wǒ men dǎ suàn quán jiā yì qǐ qù jiāo wài lù yíng.
490.en: This weekend our whole family plans to go camping in the suburbs.

491.py: Jīn tiān de tiān qì bǐ jiào nuǎn huo.

492.zh: 上课认真听讲、集中注意力是高效学习的关键。
492.py: Shàng kè rèn zhēn tīng jiǎng, jí zhōng zhù yì lì shì gāo xiào xué xí de guān jiàn.
492.en: Listening attentively in class and focusing attention is key to efficient learning.

493.zh: 学好一门外语能够搭建起跨文化交流的桥梁。
493.py: Xué hǎo yī mén wài yǔ néng gòu dā jiàn qǐ kuà wén huà jiāo liú de qiáo liáng.
493.en: Mastering a foreign language can build a bridge for cross-cultural communication.

494.zh: 教室里仅有几个学生在看书。
494.py: Jiào shì lǐ jǐn yǒu jǐ gè xué shēng zài kàn shū.
494.en: There are only a few students reading books in the classroom.

495.zh: 期末考试之前要制定合理的复习计划。
495.py: Qī mò kǎo shì zhī qián yào zhì dìng hé lǐ de fù xí jì huà.
495.en: Make a reasonable review plan before the final exam.

496.zh: 秋风拂过，金黄的落叶飘落在幽静的小道上。
496.py: Qiū fēng fú guò, jīn huáng de luò yè piāo luò zài yōu jìng de xiǎo dào shàng.
496.en: When the autumn wind brushes past, golden fallen leaves drop on the quiet path.

497.zh: 青翠的竹林在微风中轻轻摇曳，风景如画。
497.py: Qīng cuì de zhú lín zài wēi fēng zhōng qīng qīng yáo yè, fēng jǐng rú huà.
497.en: The verdant bamboo grove sways gently in the breeze, picturesque as a painting.

498.zh: 随着时代的进步，人们的生活变得越来越便利。
498.py: Suí zhe shí dài de jìn bù, rén men de shēng huó biàn dé yuè lái yuè biàn lì.
498.en: With the progress of the times, people's lives have become more and more convenient.

499.zh: 在面对多种选择时，要结合自身情况理性思考。
499.py: Zài miàn duì duō zhǒng xuǎn zé shí, yào jié hé zì shēn qíng kuàng lǐ xìng sī kǎo.
499.en: When facing multiple choices, think rationally in light of one's own situation.

500.zh: 一列高速列车在广阔的原野上飞速行驶。
500.py: Yī liè gāo sù liè chē zài guǎng kuò de yuán yě shàng fēi sù xíng shǐ.
500.en: A high-speed train travels swiftly across the vast plains.

501.zh: 他从小就喜欢练习中国武术。
501.py: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù xǐ huān liàn xí zhōng guó wǔ shù.
501.en: He has liked practicing Chinese martial arts since childhood.

502.zh: 秋天公园里的树叶变红了。
502.py: Qiū tiān gōng yuán lǐ de shù yè biàn hóng le.
502.en: The leaves in the park turned red in autumn.

503.zh: 上课铃声响了，大家快进教室。
503.py: Shàng kè líng shēng xiǎng le, dà jiā kuài jìn jiào shì.
503.en: The class bell rang, everyone quickly enter the classroom.

504.zh: 虽然今天很冷，但他还是去跑步了。
504.py: Suī rán jīn tiān hěn lěng, dàn tā hái shì qù pǎo bù le.
504.en: Although it is very cold today, he still went running.

505.py: Qǐng bāng wǒ tuī yī xià zhè shàn mén.
505.en: Please help me push this door.

506.zh: 这支球队目前的比赛势头很好。
506.py: Zhè zhī qiú duì mù qián de bǐ sài shì tou hěn hǎo.
506.en: This team's current match momentum is very good.

507.zh: 很多同学报名参加了运动会。
507.py: Hěn duō tóng xué bào míng cān jiā le yùn dòng huì.
507.en: Many classmates signed up to participate in the sports meet.

508.zh: 老师希望大家每天都能按时完成作业。
508.py: Lǎo shī xī wàng dà jiā měi tiān dōu néng àn shí wán chéng zuò yè.
508.en: The teacher hopes everyone can finish homework on time daily.

509.zh: 这是一座有一千年历史的古老小镇。
509.py: Zhè shì yī zuò yǒu yī qiān nián lì shǐ de gǔ lǎo xiǎo zhèn.
509.en: This is an ancient small town with a history of one thousand years.

510.zh: 台下坐着许多热情的观众。
510.py: Tái xià zuò zhe xǔ duō rè qíng de guān zhòng.
510.en: Many enthusiastic audience members were sitting offstage.

511.zh: 这篇作文的结构非常清晰明了。
511.py: Zhè piān zuò wén de jié gòu fēi cháng qīng xī míng liǎo.
511.en: The structure of this composition is very clear.

512.zh: 他们刚搬进了一间新房子。
512.py: Tā men gāng bān jìn le yī jiān xīn fáng zi.
512.en: They just moved into a new house.

513.zh: 我每天下午跑步半个小时。
513.py: Wǒ měi tiān xià wǔ pǎo bù bàn gè xiǎo shí.
513.en: I run for half an hour every afternoon.

514.zh: 春节是中国最重要的传统节日。
514.py: Chūn jié shì zhōng guó zuì zhòng yào de chuán tǒng jié rì.
514.en: Spring Festival is China's most important traditional festival.

515.zh: 这片土地非常适合种蔬菜。
515.py: Zhè piàn tǔ dì fēi cháng shì hé zhǒng shū cài.
515.en: This piece of land is very suitable for planting vegetables.

516.zh: 他把信件投入了街边的邮筒。
516.py: Tā bǎ xìn jiàn tóu rù le jiē biān de yóu tǒng.
516.en: He put the letter into the street mailbox.

517.zh: 某位同学把书包落在了教室里。
517.py: Mǒu wèi tóng xué bǎ shū bāo luò zài le jiào shì lǐ.
517.en: A certain classmate left their schoolbag in the classroom.

518.zh: 警方很快查清了这起案件的真相。
518.py: Jǐng fāng hěn kuài chá qīng le zhè qǐ àn jiàn de zhēn xiàng.
518.en: The police quickly found out the truth of this case.

519.zh: 天黑了，路灯都亮了起来。
519.py: Tiān hēi le, lù dēng dōu liàng le qǐ lái.
519.en: It got dark, and the streetlights all lit up.

520.zh: 我们要共同维护公共卫生与秩序。
520.py: Wǒ men yào gòng tóng wéi hù gōng gòng wèi shēng yǔ zhì xù.
520.en: We must jointly maintain public sanitation and order.

521.zh: 科技创新推动了教育方式的变革。
521.py: Kē jì chuàng xīn tuī dòng le jiào yù fāng shì de biàn gé.
521.en: Technological innovation promoted the transformation of education methods.

522.zh: 新学期我们要制定好学习计划。
522.py: Xīn xué qī wǒ men yào zhì dìng hào xué xí jì huà.
522.en: In the new semester we should make a good study plan.

523.zh: 战士们勇敢地打败了敌人。
523.py: Zhàn shì men yǒng gǎn dì dǎ bài le dí rén.
523.en: The soldiers bravely defeated the enemy.

524.zh: 他的工作态度非常细致认真。
524.py: Tā de gōng zuò tài dù fēi cháng xì zhì rèn zhēn.
524.en: His working attitude is very meticulous and conscientious.

525.zh: 客厅里陈列着许多精美的花瓶。
525.py: Kè tīng lǐ chén liè zhe xǔ duō jīng měi de huā píng.
525.en: Many exquisite vases are displayed in the living room.

526.zh: 每个人都应当严格遵守法律法规。
526.py: Měi gè rén dōu yīng dāng yán gé zūn shǒu fǎ lǜ fǎ guī.
526.en: Everyone should strictly abide by laws and regulations.

527.zh: 今天睡得很香，感觉睡眠很充足。
527.py: Jīn tiān shuì de hěn xiāng, gǎn jué shuì mián hěn chōng zú.
527.en: I slept very soundly today and feel sleep was very adequate.

528.zh: 我们要保持乐观积极的生活态度。
528.py: Wǒ men yào bǎo chí lè guān jī jí de shēng huó tài dù.
528.en: We should maintain an optimistic and positive attitude toward life.

529.zh: 我们要用心保护大自然的环境。
529.py: Wǒ men yào yòng xīn bǎo hù dà zì rán de huán jìng.
529.en: We should attentively protect the natural environment.

530.zh: 一个星期一共有七天时间。
530.py: Yí gè xīng qī yī gòng yǒu qī tiān shí jiān.
530.en: There are seven days in total in a week.

531.zh: 听到好消息，他高兴地笑了。
531.py: Tīng dào hǎo xiāo xī, tā gāo xìng dì xiào le.
531.en: Hearing the good news, he smiled happily.

532.zh: 学校派了几位优秀老师去交流。
532.py: Xué xiào pài le jǐ wèi yōu xiù lǎo shī qù jiāo liú.
532.en: The school sent several outstanding teachers for exchange.

533.zh: 那个可爱的小孩子正在画画。
533.py: Nà ge kě ài de xiǎo hái zi zhèng zài huà huà.
533.en: That cute little child is drawing a picture.

534.zh: 王老师有着丰富的教学经验。
534.py: Wáng lǎo shī yǒu zhe fēng fù de jiào xué jīng yàn.
534.en: Teacher Wang has rich teaching experience.

535.zh: 照顾好自己的身体是每个人的责任。
535.py: Zhào gù hǎo zì jǐ de shēn tǐ shì měi gè rén de zé rèn.
535.en: Taking good care of one's body is everyone's responsibility.

536.zh: 牛奶和鸡蛋含有丰富的营养。
536.py: Niú nǎi hé jī dàn hán yǒu fēng fù de yíng yǎng.
536.en: Milk and eggs contain rich nutrition.

537.zh: 夏天的夜晚，天上有很多小星星。
537.py: Xià tiān de yè wǎn, tiān shàng yǒu hěn duō xiǎo xīng xīng.
537.en: On summer nights, there are many little stars in the sky.

538.zh: 桌子上的水果足够我们大家吃了。
538.py: Zhuō zi shàng de shuǐ guǒ zú gòu wǒ men dà jiā chī le.
538.en: The fruits on the table are enough for all of us to eat.

539.zh: 请大家认真阅读课本的第三章。
539.py: Qǐng dà jiā rèn zhēn yuè dú kè běn de dì sān zhāng.
539.en: Please everyone read chapter three of the textbook carefully.

540.zh: 树林里传来了清脆的鸟鸣音乐声。
540.py: Shù lín lǐ chuán lái le qīng cuì de niǎo míng yīn yuè shēng.
540.en: Crisp birdsong and music came from the woods.

541.zh: 请大家跟着录音朗读课文。
541.py: Qǐng dà jiā gēn zhe lù yīn lǎng dú kè wén.
541.en: Please read the text aloud following the recording.

542.zh: 青年人应该树立远大的志向。
542.py: Qīng nián rén yīng gāi shù lì yuǎn dà de zhì xiàng.
542.en: Young people should establish lofty ambitions.

543.py: Qiān bǐ diào dào le zhuō zi dǐ xià.
543.en: The pencil dropped under the table.

544.zh: 我们在校门口的公交车站等车。
544.py: Wǒ men zài xiào mén kǒu de gōng jiāo chē zhàn děng chē.
544.en: We waited for the bus at the bus station by the school gate.

545.zh: 爸爸平时对我的学习要求很严格。
545.py: Bà bà píng shí duì wǒ de xué xí yāo qiú hěn yán gé.
545.en: Dad usually has very strict requirements for my study.

546.zh: 爸爸下周要去法国巴黎出差。
546.py: Bà bà xià zhōu yào qù fǎ guó bā lí chū chāi.
546.en: Dad is going to Paris, France on business next week.

547.zh: 老师在黑板上写出了一个例子。
547.py: Lǎo shī zài hēi bǎn shàng xiě chū le yí gè lì zi.
547.en: The teacher wrote an example on the blackboard.

548.zh: 出门记得带伞，以防下雨。
548.py: Chū mén jì de dài sǎn, yǐ fáng xià yǔ.
548.en: Remember to bring an umbrella when going out, to prevent rain.

549.zh: 中国是一个多民族的大家庭。
549.py: Zhōng guó shì yí gè duō mín zú de dà jiā tíng.
549.en: China is a big family of many ethnic groups.

550.zh: 图书馆为学生提供了安静的自习室。
550.py: Tú shū guǎn wèi xué shēng tí gōng le ān jìng de zì xí shì.
550.en: The library provides quiet self-study rooms for students.

551.zh: 这种学习方法的效果非常好。
551.py: Zhè zhǒng xué xí fāng fǎ de xiào guǒ fēi cháng hǎo.
551.en: The effect of this study method is very good.

552.zh: 这场大雨连续下了两天两夜。
