649.py: Měi tiān jiān chí màn pǎo duì jiàn kāng dà yǒu yì chù.
649.en: Insisting on jogging every day is of great benefit to health.

650.zh: 冬天的阳光照在身上非常温暖。
650.py: Dōng tiān de yáng guāng zhào zài shēn shàng fēi cháng wēn nuǎn.
650.en: The winter sunlight shining on the body is very warm.

651.zh: 你若有不懂的问题，随时可以问我。
651.py: Nǐ ruò yǒu bù dǒng de wèn tí, suí shí kě yǐ wèn wǒ.
651.en: If you have questions you do not understand, you can ask me anytime.

652.zh: 请问哪一路公交车去火车站？
652.py: Qǐng wèn nǎ yī lù gōng jiāo chē qù huǒ chē zhàn?
652.en: Excuse me, which bus goes to the train station?

653.zh: 老师微笑着回答了学生的问题。
653.py: Lǎo shī wēi xiào zhe huí dá le xué shēng de wèn tí.
653.en: The teacher answered the student's question with a smile.

654.zh: 他从印尼买回了一些特色咖啡。
654.py: Tā cóng yìn ní mǎi huí le yī xiē tè sè kā fēi.
654.en: He bought back some special coffee from Indonesia.

655.zh: 休息五分钟后，我们继续上课。
655.py: Xiū xī wǔ fēn zhōng hòu, wǒ men jì xù shàng kè.
655.en: After resting five minutes, we continue the class.

656.zh: 朋友送给我一本很有趣的书。
656.py: Péng yǒu sòng gěi wǒ yī běn hěn yǒu qù de shū.
656.en: A friend gave me a very interesting book.

657.zh: 遇到紧急情况请不要着急害怕。
657.py: Yù dào jǐn jí qíng kuàng qǐng bú yào zháo jí hài pà.
657.en: Please do not panic and be afraid when encountering an emergency.

658.zh: 医生通过验血检查病人的身体情况。
658.py: Yī shēng tōng guò yàn xuè jiǎn chá bìng rén de shēn tǐ qíng kuàng.
658.en: The doctor checked the patient's physical condition via a blood test.

659.zh: 突然的响声让大家吃了一惊。
659.py: Tū rán de xiǎng shēng ràng dà jiā chī le yī jīng.

660.zh: 运动前要热身，防止身体受伤。
660.py: Yùn dòng qián yào rè shēn, fáng zhǐ shēn tǐ shòu shāng.
660.en: Warm up before sports to prevent getting injured.

661.zh: 新鲜蔬菜富含人体所需的维生素。
661.py: Xīn xiān shū cài fù hán rén tǐ suǒ xū de wéi shēng sù.
661.en: Fresh vegetables are rich in vitamins required by the human body.

662.zh: 感冒了要多喝水，按时吃药。
662.py: Gǎn mào le yào duō hē shuǐ, àn shí chī yào.
662.en: When having a cold, drink more water and take medicine on time.

663.zh: 这件白衬衫非常适合你穿。
663.py: Zhè jiàn bái chèn shān fēi cháng shì hé nǐ chuān.
663.en: This white shirt suits you very well to wear.

664.zh: 微风吹过湖面，荡起小小的波浪。
664.py: Wēi fēng chuī guò hú miàn, dàng qǐ xiǎo xiǎo de bō làng.
664.en: The breeze blew across the lake surface, causing small waves.

665.zh: 夏天的夜里天气非常凉爽。
665.py: Xià tiān de yè lǐ tiān qì fēi cháng liáng shuǎng.
665.en: The weather is very cool on summer nights.

666.zh: 乘坐高铁去省城只需要一小时。
666.py: Chéng zuò gāo tiě qù shěng chéng zhǐ xū yào yī xiǎo shí.
666.en: Taking the high-speed train to the provincial capital takes only one hour.

667.zh: 在学习初级汉语时要多开口练习。
667.py: Zài xué xí chū jí hàn yǔ shí yào duō kāi kǒu liàn xí.
667.en: When learning beginner Chinese, practice speaking more.

668.zh: 他非常喜欢读书和听音乐。
668.py: Tā fēi cháng xǐ huān dú shū hé tīng yīn yuè.
668.en: He likes reading and listening to music very much.

669.zh: 饭前洗手是一个好卫生习惯。
669.py: Fàn qián xǐ shǒu shì yí gè hǎo wèi shēng xí guàn.
669.en: Washing hands before meals is a good hygiene habit.

670.zh: 水是生命之源，我们要节约用水。
670.py: Shuǐ shì shēng mìng zhī yuán, wǒ men yào jié yuē yòng shuǐ.
670.en: Water is the source of life, we must conserve water.

671.zh: 北京有很多好吃的传统美食。
671.py: Běi jīng yǒu hěn duō hǎo chī de chuán tǒng měi shí.
671.en: Beijing has a lot of delicious traditional delicacies.

672.zh: 过马路时不要看手机，太危险了。
672.py: Guò mǎ lù shí bú yào kàn shǒu jī, tài wēi xiǎn le.
672.en: Do not look at your phone when crossing the road, it is too dangerous.

673.zh: 我们热情地招待了远方的客人。
673.py: Wǒ men rè qíng dì zhāo dài le yuǎn fāng de kè rén.
673.en: We warmly hosted the guests from afar.

674.zh: 他详细叙述了昨天发生的事情。
674.py: Tā xiáng xì xù shù le zuó tiān fā shēng de shì qíng.
674.en: He narrated what happened yesterday in detail.

675.zh: 亚洲是世界上陆地面积最大的大洲。
675.py: Yà zhōu shì shì jiè shàng lù dì miàn jī zuì dà de dà zhōu.
675.en: Asia is the continent with the largest land area in the world.

676.zh: 我们要养成每天复习的好习惯。
676.py: Wǒ men yào yǎng chéng měi tiān fù xí de hǎo xí guàn.
676.en: We should develop the good habit of reviewing every day.

677.zh: 桌子上放置着一台新电脑。
677.py: Zhuō zi shàng fàng zhì zhe yī tái xīn diàn nǎo.
677.en: A new computer is placed on the desk.

678.zh: 他在这里居住了很多年了。
678.py: Tā zài zhè lǐ jū zhù le hěn duō nián le.
678.en: He has lived here for many years.

679.zh: 辛勤的劳动能创造美好的生活。
679.py: Xīn qín de láo dòng néng chuàng zào měi hǎo de shēng huó.
679.en: Hard labor can create a beautiful life.

680.zh: 知识是我们人生中最宝贵的财富。
680.py: Zhī shí shì wǒ men rén shēng zhōng zuì bǎo guì de cái fù.
680.en: Knowledge is the most precious wealth in our life.

681.zh: 图书馆的学习环境非常安静。
681.py: Tú shū guǎn de xué xí huán jìng fēi cháng ān jìng.
681.en: The study environment in the library is very quiet.

682.zh: 大家在食堂门口排队买饭。
682.py: Dà jiā zài shí táng mén kǒu pái duì mǎi fàn.
682.en: Everyone lined up at the canteen entrance to buy food.

683.zh: 祝你新的一年幸福快乐！
683.py: Zhù nǐ xīn de yī nián xìng fú kuài lè!
683.en: Wish you happiness and joy in the new year!

684.zh: 这家公司今年吸纳了许多新员工。
684.py: Zhè jiā gōng sī jīn nián xī nà le xǔ duō xīn yuán gōng.
684.en: This company recruited many new employees this year.

685.zh: 欢快的音乐声在操场上响起。
685.py: Huān kuài de yīn yuè shēng zài cāo chǎng shàng xiǎng qǐ.
685.en: Cheerful music sounded on the sports field.

686.zh: 夏天的午后经常会打雷下雨。
686.py: Xià tiān de wǔ hòu jīng cháng huì dǎ léi xià yǔ.
686.en: It often thunders and rains on summer afternoons.

687.zh: 遇到危险时请立即报警求助。
687.py: Yù dào wēi xiǎn shí qǐng lì jí bào jǐng qiú zhù.
687.en: Please call the police immediately when in danger.

688.zh: 他在本次数学竞赛中荣获了一等奖。
688.py: Tā zài běn cì shù xué jìng sài zhōng róng huò le yì děng jiǎng.
688.en: He won first prize in this math competition.

689.zh: 他是全班同学学习的好模范。
689.py: Tā shì quán bān tóng xué xué xí de hǎo mó fàn.
689.en: He is a good model for the whole class to learn from.

690.zh: 上课前要把手机电量充满。
690.py: Shàng kè qián yào bǎ shǒu jī diàn liàng chōng mǎn.
690.en: Charge the phone fully before class.

691.zh: 李老师对工作非常负责认真。
691.py: Lǐ lǎo shī duì gōng zuò fēi cháng fù zé rèn zhēn.
691.en: Teacher Li is very responsible and conscientious in work.

692.zh: 蓝天上飘着几朵白云，真好看。
692.py: Lán tiān shàng piāo zhe jǐ duǒ bái yún, zhēn hǎo kàn.
692.en: A few white clouds float in the blue sky, really pretty.

693.zh: 请把自行车停在停车区内。
693.py: Qǐng bǎ zì xíng chē tíng zài tíng chē qū nèi.
693.en: Please park the bicycle in the parking area.

694.zh: 公园里有很多绿色的树木。
694.py: Gōng yuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō lǜ sè de shù mù.
694.en: There are many green trees in the park.

695.zh: 夏天去海边游泳非常凉快。
695.py: Xià tiān qù hǎi biān yóu yǒng fēi cháng liáng kuài.
695.en: Going to the seaside to swim in summer is very cool.

696.zh: 中国人在端午节有划龙舟的传统。
696.py: Zhōng guó rén zài duān wǔ jié yǒu huà lóng zhōu de chuán tǒng.
696.en: Chinese people have the tradition of rowing dragon boats on Dragon Boat Festival.

697.zh: 门前有一棵高大的银杏树。
697.py: Mén qián yǒu yī kē gāo dà de yín xìng shù.
697.en: There is a tall ginkgo tree in front of the door.

698.zh: 不懂的问题不要怀疑，直接问老师。
698.py: Bù dǒng de wèn tí bú yào huái yí, zhí jiē wèn lǎo shī.
698.en: Do not doubt questions you don't understand, ask the teacher directly.

699.zh: 我家住在六层，楼下是一个小花园。
699.py: Wǒ jiā zhù zài liù céng, lóu xià shì yí gè xiǎo huā yuán.
699.en: My home is on the sixth floor, downstairs is a small garden.

700.zh: 今天天气很冷，出门记得多穿衣服。
700.py: Jīn tiān tiān qì hěn lěng, chū mén jì de duō chuān yī fú.
700.en: The weather is very cold today, remember to wear more clothes when going out.

701.zh: 中国位于美丽的亚洲东部。
701.py: Zhōng guó wèi yú měi lì de yà zhōu dōng bù.
701.en: China is located in the eastern part of beautiful Asia.

702.zh: 他冲了一杯热茶暖身子。
702.py: Tā chōng le yī bēi rè chá nuǎn shēn zi.
702.en: He made a cup of hot tea to warm his body.

703.zh: 早晨阳光照射进明亮的房间里。
703.py: Zǎo chén yáng guāng zhào shè jìn míng liàng de fáng jiān lǐ.
703.en: Morning sunlight shines into the bright room.

704.zh: 老师简略总结了课文的重点。
704.py: Lǎo shī jiǎn lüè zǒng jié le kè wén de zhòng diǎn.
704.en: The teacher briefly summarized the key points of the text.

705.zh: 他是我们大家学习的优秀典范。
705.py: Tā shì wǒ men dà jiā xué xí de yōu xiù diǎn fàn.
705.en: He is an outstanding model for all of us to learn from.

706.zh: 他竟然在一天之内读完了这本厚书。
706.py: Tā jìng rán zài yī tiān zhī nèi dú wán le zhè běn hòu shū.
706.en: He actually finished reading this thick book within one day.

707.zh: 请用这个生词造一个完整的句子。
707.py: Qǐng yòng zhè ge shēng cí zào yí gè wán zhěng de jù zi.
707.en: Please make a complete sentence using this new word.

708.zh: 走进教室，大家都在安静地看书。
708.py: Zǒu jìn jiào shì, dà jiā dōu zài ān jìng dì kàn shū.
708.en: Entering the classroom, everyone is reading books quietly.

709.zh: 这两本书的内容有很大差异。
709.py: Zhè liǎng běn shū de nèi róng yǒu hěn dà chā yì.
709.en: The contents of these two books have great differences.

710.zh: 老师的话极大激发了大家的兴趣。
710.py: Lǎo shī de huà jí dà jī fā le dà jiā de xìng qù.
710.en: The teacher's words greatly stimulated everyone's interest.

711.zh: 学习汉字能帮助我们了解中国文化。
711.py: Xué xí hàn zì néng bāng zhù wǒ men liǎo jiě zhōng guó wén huà.
711.en: Learning Chinese characters can help us understand Chinese culture.

712.zh: 爷爷住在一个安静美丽的小山村里。
712.py: Yé yé zhù zài yí gè ān jìng měi lì de xiǎo shān cūn lǐ.
712.en: Grandpa lives in a quiet and beautiful small mountain village.

713.zh: 听到这个笑话，大家都哈哈大笑起来。
713.py: Tīng dào zhè ge xiào huà, dà jiā dōu hā hā dà xiào qǐ lái.
713.en: Hearing this joke, everyone laughed out loud heartily.

714.zh: 公司制定了新的销售策略。
714.py: Gōng sī zhì dìng le xīn de xiāo shòu cè lüè.
714.en: The company formulated a new sales strategy.

715.zh: 今晚学校礼堂有一场精彩的演出。
715.py: Jīn wǎn xué xiào lǐ táng yǒu yī cháng jīng cǎi de yǎn chū.
715.en: There is a wonderful performance in the school auditorium tonight.

716.zh: 这道数学题其实非常简单易懂。
716.py: Zhè dào shù xué tí qí shí fēi cháng jiǎn dān yì dǒng.
716.en: This math problem is actually very simple and easy to understand.

717.zh: 进图书馆前请出示您的借书卡。
717.py: Jìn tú shū guǎn qián qǐng chū shì nín de jiè shū kǎ.
717.en: Please show your library card before entering the library.

718.zh: 每个人都应当遵守法律，切勿犯罪。
718.py: Měi gè rén dōu yīng dāng zūn shǒu fǎ lǜ, qiè wù fàn zuì.
718.en: Everyone should obey the law and never commit crimes.

719.zh: 法官做出了公正的判决。
719.py: Fǎ guān zuò chū le gōng zhèng de pàn jué.
719.en: The judge made a fair verdict.

720.zh: 青年人要勇于承担责任。
720.py: Qīng nián rén yào yǒng yú chéng dān zé rèn.
720.en: Young people should dare to undertake responsibilities.

721.zh: 杭州是一座风景优美的旅游城市。
721.py: Háng zhōu shì yī zuò fēng jǐng yōu měi de lǚ yóu chéng shì.
721.en: Hangzhou is a tourist city with scenic beauty.

722.zh: 请大家在图书馆里保持安静。
722.py: Qǐng dà jiā zài tú shū guǎn lǐ bǎo chí ān jìng.
722.en: Please keep quiet in the library, everyone.

723.zh: 遇到暂时的困难不要退缩。
723.py: Yù dào zàn shí de kùn nán bú yào tuì suō.
723.en: Do not shrink back when encountering temporary difficulties.

724.zh: 这种文具既便宜又非常实用。
724.py: Zhè zhǒng wén jù jì pián yi yòu fēi cháng shí yòng.
724.en: This stationery is both cheap and very practical.

725.zh: 天气变冷了，多穿一件厚大衣吧。
725.py: Tiān qì biàn lěng le, duō chuān yī jiàn hòu dà yī ba.
725.en: The weather turned cold, wear an extra thick coat.

726.zh: 老师您好，祝您教师节快乐！
726.py: Lǎo shī nín hǎo, zhù nín jiào shī jié kuài lè!
726.en: Hello teacher, wish you a happy Teachers' Day!

727.zh: 这所学校的办学宗旨是培养优秀人才。
727.py: Zhè suǒ xué xiào de bàn xué zōng zhǐ shì péi yǎng yōu xiù rén cái.
727.en: The founding purpose of this school is to cultivate outstanding talents.

728.zh: 每天坚持积累生词能扩大词汇量。
728.py: Měi tiān jiān chí jī lěi shēng cí néng kuò dà cí huì liàng.
728.en: Persisting in accumulating new words daily can expand vocabulary.

729.zh: 在课余时间，他喜欢画画和弹琴。
729.py: Zài kè yú shí jiān, tā xǐ huān huà huà hé tán qín.
729.en: In spare time after class, he likes drawing and playing the piano.

730.zh: 经过治疗，他的牙痛完全好了。
730.py: Jīng guò zhì liáo, tā de yá tòng wán quán hǎo le.
730.en: After treatment, his toothache was completely cured.

731.zh: 交试卷之前要仔细检查一遍。
731.py: Jiāo shì juàn zhī qián yào zǐ xì jiǎn chá yī biàn.
731.en: Check carefully once before handing in the exam paper.

732.zh: 他的数学成绩比以前进步了不少，差错变少了。
732.py: Tā de shù xué chéng jì bǐ yǐ qián jìn bù le bù shǎo, chā cuò biàn shǎo le.
732.en: His math grades improved a lot compared to before, with fewer errors.

733.zh: 多读书可以丰富我们的知识面。
733.py: Duō dú shū kě yǐ fēng fù wǒ men de zhī shí miàn.
733.en: Reading more books can enrich our knowledge base.

734.zh: 大自然给艺术家带来了许多灵感。
734.py: Dà zì rán gěi yì shù jiā dài lái le xǔ duō líng gǎn.
734.en: Nature brought a lot of inspiration to the artist.

735.zh: 大家团结协作，很快完成了任务。
735.py: Dà jiā tuán jié xié zuò, hěn kuài wán chéng le rèn wù.
735.en: Everyone collaborated together and completed the task quickly.

736.zh: 从不同角度看问题会有新发现。
736.py: Cóng bù tóng jiǎo dù kàn wèn tí huì yǒu xīn fā xiàn.
736.en: Looking at problems from different angles yields new discoveries.

737.zh: 阅读占据了他大部分的空闲时间。
737.py: Yuè dú zhàn jù le tā dà bù fèn de kòng xián shí jiān.
737.en: Reading occupies most of his free time.

738.zh: 合理搭配蔬菜和肉类对健康好。
738.py: Hé lǐ dā pèi shū cài hé ròu lèi duì jiàn kāng hǎo.
738.en: Matching vegetables and meat reasonably is good for health.

739.zh: 大雁南飞是秋天到来的自然特征。
739.py: Dà yàn nán fēi shì qiū tiān dào lái de zì rán tè zhēng.
739.en: Wild geese flying south is a natural feature of autumn's arrival.

740.zh: 爸爸正在院子里修理自行车。
740.py: Bà bà zhèng zài yuàn zi lǐ xiū lǐ zì xíng chē.
740.en: Dad is repairing a bicycle in the courtyard.

741.zh: 新鲜的橘子皮有清新的香味。
741.py: Xīn xiān de jú zi pí yǒu qīng xīn de xiāng wèi.
741.en: Fresh orange peel has a fresh fragrance.

742.zh: 他微笑着向大家挥手道别。
742.py: Tā wēi xiào zhe xiàng dà jiā huī shǒu dào bié.
742.en: He smiled and waved goodbye to everyone.

743.zh: 我们班在足球比赛中取得了胜利。
743.py: Wǒ men bān zài zú qiú bǐ sài zhōng qǔ dé le shèng lì.
743.en: Our class achieved victory in the soccer match.

744.zh: 今天晚上的气温明显下降了。
744.py: Jīn tiān wǎn shàng de qì wēn míng xiǎn xià jiàng le.

745.zh: 我们要一步一个台阶地踏实前行。
745.py: Wǒ men yào yī bù yí gè tái jiē dì tà shí qián xíng.
745.en: We must advance steadily one step at a time.

746.zh: 老师正在认真审查同学们的作业。
746.py: Lǎo shī zhèng zài rèn zhēn shěn chá tóng xué men de zuò yè.
746.en: The teacher is carefully reviewing the students' homework.

747.zh: 遇到急事时一定要保持沉着冷静。
747.py: Yù dào jí shì shí yí dìng yào bǎo chí chén zhuó lěng jìng.
747.en: When encountering urgent matters, be sure to keep calm and composed.

748.zh: 我们要坚持每天练习听力和口语。
748.py: Wǒ men yào jiān chí měi tiān liàn xí tīng lì hé kǒu yǔ.
748.en: We must persist in practicing listening and speaking every day.

749.zh: 他是一个非常善良友好的同学。
749.py: Tā shì yí gè fēi cháng shàn liáng yǒu hǎo de tóng xué.
749.en: He is a very kind and friendly classmate.

750.zh: 妈妈做的西红柿炒鸡蛋特别好吃。
750.py: Mā mā zuò de xī hóng shì chǎo jī dàn tè bié hǎo chī.
750.en: The tomato scrambled eggs cooked by mom is especially delicious.

751.zh: 刘老师是我们的汉语老师。
751.py: Liú lǎo shī shì wǒ men de hàn yǔ lǎo shī.
751.en: Teacher Liu is our Chinese teacher.

752.zh: 他每天早晨都大声朗读课文。
752.py: Tā měi tiān zǎo chén dōu dà shēng lǎng dú kè wén.
752.en: He reads texts aloud every morning.

753.py: Zhè lǐ de fēng jǐng zhēn měi lì a!
753.en: The scenery here is really beautiful!

754.zh: 学校旁边有一家大型超市。
754.py: Xué xiào páng biān yǒu yī jiā dà xíng chāo shì.
754.en: There is a large supermarket next to the school.

755.zh: 今天参观博物馆是免费的。
755.py: Jīn tiān cān guān bó wù guǎn shì miǎn fèi de.
755.en: Visiting the museum today is free of charge.

756.zh: 学会放松可以减轻学习压力。
756.py: Xué huì fàng sōng kě yǐ jiǎn qīng xué xí yā lì.
756.en: Learning to relax can reduce study pressure.

757.zh: 学校门口有一家中国银行。
757.py: Xué xiào mén kǒu yǒu yī jiā zhōng guó yín háng.
757.en: There is a Bank of China at the school entrance.

758.zh: 我想去书店买两本新词典。
758.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù shū diàn mǎi liǎng běn xīn cí diǎn.
758.en: I want to go to the bookstore to buy two new dictionaries.

759.zh: 故宫是古代皇帝住的地方。
759.py: Gù gōng shì gǔ dài huáng dì zhù de dì fāng.
759.en: The Forbidden City is where ancient emperors lived.

760.zh: 奶奶在院子里养了很多花草。
760.py: Nǎi nǎi zài yuàn zi lǐ yǎng le hěn duō huā cǎo.
760.en: Grandma raised a lot of flowers and plants in the courtyard.

761.zh: 伊拉克是一个中东国家。
761.py: Yī lā kè shì yí gè zhōng dōng guó jiā.
761.en: Iraq is a Middle Eastern country.

762.zh: 我们要常怀一颗感恩的心。
762.py: Wǒ men yào cháng huái yī kē gǎn ēn de xīn.
762.en: We should always have a grateful heart.

763.py: Tā zuò shì fēi cháng rèn zhēn zhí zhuó.
763.en: He is very conscientious and persistent in doing things.

764.zh: 王老师是我们学校的副校长。
764.py: Wáng lǎo shī shì wǒ men xué xiào de fù xiào zhǎng.
764.en: Teacher Wang is the vice principal of our school.

765.zh: 请不要在教室里乱扔垃圾。
765.py: Qǐng bú yào zài jiào shì lǐ luàn rēng lā jī.
765.en: Please do not litter garbage in the classroom.

766.zh: 坚持锻炼能增强身体抵抗力。
766.py: Jiān chí duàn liàn néng zēng qiáng shēn tǐ dǐ kàng lì.
766.en: Persisting in exercise can enhance body resistance.

767.zh: 知道犯错了就要及时改正。
767.py: Zhī dào fàn cuò le jiù yào jí shí gǎi zhèng.
767.en: When you know you made a mistake, correct it promptly.

768.zh: 小狗在草地上欢快地追逐小球。
768.py: Xiǎo gǒu zài cǎo dì shàng huān kuài dì zhuī zhú xiǎo qiú.
768.en: The puppy is chasing the small ball cheerfully on the grass.

769.zh: 你能帮我拿一下这本书吗？
769.py: Nǐ néng bāng wǒ ná yī xià zhè běn shū ma?
769.en: Can you help me hold this book for a moment?

770.zh: 老师宣布了明天放假的好消息。
770.py: Lǎo shī xuān bù le míng tiān fàng jià de hǎo xiāo xī.
770.en: The teacher announced the good news of tomorrow's holiday.

771.zh: 山顶上有一座古老的佛像。
771.py: Shān dǐng shàng yǒu yī zuò gǔ lǎo de fó xiàng.
771.en: There is an ancient Buddha statue on the mountain peak.

772.zh: 小弟弟今年刚满六岁了。
772.py: Xiǎo dì dì jīn nián gāng mǎn liù suì le.
772.en: Little brother has just turned six years old this year.

773.zh: 中国航天取得了巨大的进步。
773.py: Zhōng guó háng tiān qǔ dé le jù dà de jìn bù.
773.en: China's aerospace has made tremendous progress.

774.zh: 他的考试成绩非常优秀。
774.py: Tā de kǎo shì chéng jì fēi cháng yōu xiù.
774.en: His exam results are very excellent.

775.zh: 这里的石头形状非常奇怪有趣。
775.py: Zhè lǐ de shí tou xíng zhuàng fēi cháng qí guài yǒu qù.
775.en: The stone shapes here are very strange and interesting.

776.zh: 这碗热汤闻起来真香啊。
776.py: Zhè wǎn rè tāng wén qǐ lái zhēn xiāng a.
776.en: This bowl of hot soup smells really fragrant.

777.zh: 他是世界著名的文学家。
777.py: Tā shì shì jiè zhù míng de wén xué jiā.

778.zh: 春天农民在农田里播种小麦。
778.py: Chūn tiān nóng mín zài nóng tián lǐ bō zhǒng xiǎo mài.
778.en: In spring, farmers sow wheat in the farmland.

779.zh: 我们可以坐高铁去北京旅行。
779.py: Wǒ men kě yǐ zuò gāo tiě qù běi jīng lǚ xíng.
779.en: We can take high-speed rail to travel to Beijing.

780.zh: 平时要控制看手机的时间。
780.py: Píng shí yào kòng zhì kàn shǒu jī de shí jiān.
780.en: Usually control the time spent looking at mobile phones.

781.zh: 依法纳税是每个公民的责任。
781.py: Yī fǎ nà shuì shì měi gè gōng mín de zé rèn.
781.en: Paying taxes according to law is the duty of every citizen.

782.zh: 在前面的路口向左拐就到了。
782.py: Zài qián miàn de lù kǒu xiàng zuǒ guǎi jiù dào le.
782.en: Turn left at the intersection ahead and you will arrive.

783.zh: 过马路要先看左边再看右边。
783.py: Guò mǎ lù yào xiān kàn zuǒ biān zài kàn yòu biān.
783.en: Look left first then look right when crossing the road.

784.zh: 请给我一份今天的报纸。
784.py: Qǐng gěi wǒ yī fèn jīn tiān de bào zhǐ.
784.en: Please give me a copy of today's newspaper.

785.zh: 外面很冷，快穿上厚外套吧。
785.py: Wài miàn hěn lěng, kuài chuān shàng hòu wài tào ba.
785.en: It's cold outside, quickly put on a thick coat.

786.zh: 他从小就对绘画艺术感兴趣。
786.py: Tā cóng xiǎo jiù duì huì huà yì shù gǎn xìng qù.
786.en: He has been interested in painting art since childhood.

787.zh: 他每天早晨在阳台上背单词。
787.py: Tā měi tiān zǎo chén zài yáng tái shàng bèi dān cí.
787.en: He memorizes words on the balcony every morning.

788.zh: 刚才窗外下了一阵小雨。
788.py: Gāng cái chuāng wài xià le yī zhèn xiǎo yǔ.
788.en: A shower of light rain fell outside the window just now.

789.zh: 春天的草地上开满了小花。
789.py: Chūn tiān de cǎo dì shàng kāi mǎn le xiǎo huā.
789.en: The spring grassland is filled with little flowers.

790.zh: 今天走路太多，脚有点酸痛。
790.py: Jīn tiān zǒu lù tài duō, jiǎo yǒu diǎn suān tòng.
790.en: Walked too much today, feet are a bit sore.

791.zh: 请大概讲一下这个故事的内容。
791.py: Qǐng dà gài jiǎng yī xià zhè ge gù shì de nèi róng.
791.en: Please briefly describe the content of this story roughly.

792.zh: 我们要改掉生活中的不良恶习。
792.py: Wǒ men yào gǎi diào shēng huó zhōng de bù liáng è xí.
792.en: We should correct bad habits in life.

793.zh: 妈妈把西瓜切成了一小块一小块。
793.py: Mā mā bǎ xī guā qiè chéng le yī xiǎo kuài yī xiǎo kuài.
793.en: Mom sliced the watermelon into small pieces.

794.zh: 我们一起吃了一顿丰盛的晚餐。
794.py: Wǒ men yì qǐ chī le yī dùn fēng shèng de wǎn cān.
794.en: We had a hearty dinner together.

795.zh: 他很勇敢，敢于承认错误。
795.py: Tā hěn yǒng gǎn, gǎn yú chéng rèn cuò wù.
795.en: He is very brave and dares to admit mistakes.

796.zh: 每个人都应当自觉遵守交通规则。
796.py: Měi gè rén dōu yīng dāng zì jué zūn shǒu jiāo tōng guī zé.
796.en: Everyone should consciously obey traffic rules.

797.zh: 爸爸平时喜欢喝一点红葡萄酒。
797.py: Bà bà píng shí xǐ huān hē yì diǎn hóng pú táo jiǔ.
797.en: Dad usually likes drinking a little red wine.

798.zh: 海南岛是一座美丽的旅游海岛。
798.py: Hǎi nán dǎo shì yī zuò měi lì de lǚ yóu hǎi dǎo.
798.en: Hainan Island is a beautiful tourist island.

799.zh: 他把行李托付给朋友照看。
799.py: Tā bǎ xíng lǐ tuō fù gěi péng yǒu zhào kàn.
799.en: He entrusted his luggage to a friend to look after.

800.zh: 湖中央有一座漂亮的小亭子。
800.py: Hú zhōng yāng yǒu yī zuò piào liàng de xiǎo tíng zi.
800.en: There is a pretty little pavilion in the center of the lake.

801.zh: 早晨推开窗户，空气非常清新。
801.py: Zǎo chén tuī kāi chuāng hù, kōng qì fēi cháng qīng xīn.
801.en: Pushing open the window in early morning, the air is very fresh.

802.zh: 操场上正在进行激烈的篮球比赛。
802.py: Cāo chǎng shàng zhèng zài jìn xíng jī liè de lán qiú bǐ sài.
802.en: An intense basketball match is going on in the sports field.

803.zh: 太平洋是地球上最大的大洋。
803.py: Tài píng yáng shì dì qiú shàng zuì dà de dà yáng.
803.en: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.

804.zh: 我哥哥是一名优秀的医生。
804.py: Wǒ gē gē shì yī míng yōu xiù de yī shēng.
804.en: My elder brother is an excellent doctor.

805.zh: 科学家正在探索未知的太空世界。
805.py: Kē xué jiā zhèng zài tàn suǒ wèi zhī de tài kōng shì jiè.
805.en: Scientists are exploring the unknown outer space world.

806.zh: 北京的传统胡同很有特色。
806.py: Běi jīng de chuán tǒng hú tòng hěn yǒu tè sè.
806.en: Beijing's traditional hutongs are very distinctive.

807.zh: 这款新手机的外观非常漂亮。
807.py: Zhè kuǎn xīn shǒu jī de wài guān fēi cháng piào liàng.
807.en: The appearance of this new phone is very beautiful.

808.zh: 取得好成绩要靠自己的努力。
808.py: Qǔ dé hǎo chéng jì yào kào zì jǐ de nǔ lì.
808.en: Achieving good grades depends on one's own efforts.

809.zh: 老师对他的作文给出了高评价。
809.py: Lǎo shī duì tā de zuò wén gěi chū le gāo píng jià.
809.en: The teacher gave a high evaluation to his essay.

810.zh: 这是今天出版的最新版报纸。
810.py: Zhè shì jīn tiān chū bǎn de zuì xīn bǎn bào zhǐ.
810.en: This is the latest edition of the newspaper published today.

811.zh: 大熊猫是中国的国宝动物。
811.py: Dà xióng māo shì zhōng guó de guó bǎo dòng wù.
811.en: The giant panda is China's national treasure animal.

812.zh: 山脚下有一座安静的图书馆。
812.py: Shān jiǎo xià yǒu yī zuò ān jìng de tú shū guǎn.
812.en: There is a quiet library at the foot of the mountain.

813.zh: 老师耐心地解释了这道题的答案。
813.py: Lǎo shī nài xīn dì jiě shì le zhè dào tí de dá àn.
813.en: The teacher patiently explained the answer to this problem.

814.zh: 这里的风景优美，非常适合拍照。
814.py: Zhè lǐ de fēng jǐng yōu měi, fēi cháng shì hé pāi zhào.
814.en: The scenery here is beautiful, very suitable for taking photos.

815.zh: 妈妈细心地照顾生病的弟弟。
815.py: Mā mā xì xīn dì zhào gù shēng bìng de dì di.
815.en: Mom carefully takes care of the sick younger brother.

816.zh: 弟弟正在书桌前认真写作业。
816.py: Dì di zhèng zài shū zhuō qián rèn zhēn xiě zuò yè.
816.en: Younger brother is writing homework seriously at the desk.

817.zh: 我们在这个周末去爬山登高吧。
817.py: Wǒ men zài zhè ge zhōu mò qù pá shān dēng gāo ba.
817.en: Let's go climb the mountain this weekend.

818.zh: 网上买的货物今天下午送到了。
818.py: Wǎng shàng mǎi de huò wù jīn tiān xià wǔ sòng dào le.
818.en: The goods bought online were delivered this afternoon.

819.zh: 同学们在学习上应该互相帮助。
819.py: Tóng xué men zài xué xí shàng yīng gāi hù xiāng bāng zhù.
819.en: Students should help each other in studying.

820.zh: 他在收银台用手机付了钱。
820.py: Tā zài shōu yín tái yòng shǒu jī fù le qián.
820.en: He paid money with his phone at the cashier counter.

821.zh: 王大伯是一位热心助人的邻居。
821.py: Wáng dà bó shì yī wèi rè xīn zhù rén de lín jū.
821.en: Uncle Wang is a helpful neighbor.

822.zh: 请你说得慢一点儿，我听不清。
822.py: Qǐng nǐ shuō dé màn yì diǎn ér, wǒ tīng bù qīng.
822.en: Please speak a bit slower, I can't hear clearly.

823.zh: 他打算在今年暑假去欧洲旅游。
823.py: Tā dǎ suàn zài jīn nián shǔ jià qù ōu zhōu lǚ yóu.
823.en: He plans to travel to Europe this summer vacation.

824.zh: 我想去银行把美元换成人民币。
824.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù yín háng bǎ měi yuán huàn chéng rén mín bì.
824.en: I want to go to the bank to exchange US dollars for RMB.

825.zh: 院子里的花开得很香，很好闻。
825.py: Yuàn zi lǐ de huā kāi de hěn xiāng, hěn hǎo wén.
825.en: The flowers in the courtyard bloom fragrantly, smelling very nice.

826.zh: 在马路上乱跑是一件很危险的事。
826.py: Zài mǎ lù shàng luàn pǎo shì yī jiàn hěn wēi xiǎn de shì.
826.en: Running around on the road is a very dangerous thing.

827.zh: 妈妈最近工作非常忙碌。
827.py: Mā mā zuì jìn gōng zuò fēi cháng máng lù.
827.en: Mom has been very busy with work recently.

828.zh: 多吃苹果别忘了把苹果核扔掉。
828.py: Duō chī píng guǒ bié wàng le bǎ píng guǒ hé rēng diào.
828.en: When eating apples don't forget to throw away the apple core.

829.zh: 房间里光线太暗了，把灯打开吧。
829.py: Fáng jiān lǐ guāng xiàn tài àn le, bǎ dēng dǎ kāi ba.
829.en: The light in the room is too dim, turn on the light.

830.zh: 姐姐比我大两岁，正在读大学。
830.py: Jiě jiě bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì, zhèng zài dú dà xué.
830.en: Elder sister is two years older than me, studying in university.

831.zh: 老师向大家介绍了新来的同学。
831.py: Lǎo shī xiàng dà jiā jiè shào le xīn lái de tóng xué.
831.en: The teacher introduced the new classmate to everyone.

832.zh: 这台旧电视机坏了，不能看了。
832.py: Zhè tái jiù diàn shì jī huài le, bù néng kàn le.
832.en: This old TV is broken and cannot be watched.

833.zh: 我们正在讨论周末去哪里玩。
833.py: Wǒ men zhèng zài tǎo lùn zhōu mò qù nǎ lǐ wán.
833.en: We are discussing where to go play on the weekend.

834.zh: 春天公园里的花朵美丽极了。
834.py: Chūn tiān gōng yuán lǐ de huā duǒ měi lì jí le.
834.en: The flowers in the park in spring are extremely beautiful.

835.zh: 养成良好的生活习惯非常重要。
835.py: Yǎng chéng liáng hǎo de shēng huó xí guàn fēi cháng zhòng yào.
835.en: Developing good living habits is very important.

836.zh: 请大家按顺序排队上车。
836.py: Qǐng dà jiā àn shùn xù pái duì shàng chē.
836.en: Please line up in order to board the bus, everyone.

837.zh: 太阳从东方缓缓升起来了。
837.py: Tài yáng cóng dōng fāng huǎn huǎn shēng qǐ lái le.
837.en: The sun rose slowly from the east.

838.zh: 考场里有两位监考老师。
838.py: Kǎo chǎng lǐ yǒu liǎng wèi jiān kǎo lǎo shī.
838.en: There are two invigilating teachers in the exam room.

839.zh: 考试临近了，大家都在认真复习。
839.py: Kǎo shì lín jìn le, dà jiā dōu zài rèn zhēn fù xí.
839.en: As the exam draws near, everyone is reviewing seriously.

840.zh: 天亮了，该起床去上学了。
840.py: Tiān liàng le, gāi qǐ chuáng qù shàng xué le.
840.en: It is dawn, time to get up and go to school.

841.zh: 早晨草叶上挂着晶莹的露珠。
841.py: Zǎo chén cǎo yè shàng guà zhe jīng yíng de lù zhū.
841.en: Crystal-clear dewdrops hang on grass leaves in the morning.

842.zh: 我们要永远珍惜美好的友谊。
842.py: Wǒ men yào yǒng yuǎn zhēn xī měi hǎo de yǒu yì.
842.en: We should forever cherish beautiful friendship.

843.zh: 清晨到公园里呼吸新鲜空气吧。
843.py: Qīng chén dào gōng yuán lǐ hū xī xīn xiān kōng qì ba.
843.en: Go breathe fresh air in the park in early morning.

844.zh: 这道菜的味道非常可口鲜美。
844.py: Zhè dào cài de wèi dào fēi cháng kě kǒu xiān měi.
844.en: The taste of this dish is very delicious and fresh.

845.zh: 周末我们全家一起去郊外野餐。
845.py: Zhōu mò wǒ men quán jiā yì qǐ qù jiāo wài yě cān.
845.en: On the weekend our whole family goes on an outdoor picnic in the suburbs.

855.en: A few colorful small boats are moored in the bay.

860.en: As long as you are willing to work hard, you can definitely learn it.

861.py: Jīn tiān xué xiào duì xué shēng jìn xíng le shì lì cè shì.
861.en: The school conducted eyesight tests on students today.

862.zh: 不要害怕失败，失败是成功之母。
862.py: Bú yào hài pà shī bài, shī bài shì chéng gōng zhī mǔ.
862.en: Do not fear failure, failure is the mother of success.

863.py: Dōng tiān wū zi lǐ shēng zhe wēn nuǎn de nuǎn qì.
863.en: Warm heating is on in the room during winter.

864.en: He goes running on the sports field every morning to exercise.

865.py: Zuó wǎn wǒ zuò le yí gè fēi cháng měi hǎo de mèng.
865.en: Last night I had a very wonderful dream.

866.en: After finishing dinner, let's go take a walk in the park.

881.en: That young lady is a newly arrived nurse.

882.en: I go to the library with good friends on weekends.

883.en: Younger sister drew a cute little cat on white paper.

887.en: The weather is cold in winter, put on a hat to protect your ears.

888.py: Wǒ men yào gǎn xiè fù mǔ de yǎng yù zhī ēn.
888.en: We should thank our parents for their grace of raising us.

889.en: This pencil has been used too short, time to change for a new one.

890.en: The wonderful performance won warm applause.

895.py: Shān pō shàng zhǎng zhe xǔ duō gāo dà de sōng shù.

899.en: On the way to school, I ran into an old classmate.

900.en: Wish grandpa and grandma good health and a long life!

901.py: Zài zuò zhòng yào jué dìng qián yào zǐ xì kǎo lǜ.
901.en: Think carefully before making important decisions.

902.py: Jīn tiān néng rèn shí nǐ, wǒ gǎn dào fēi cháng xìng yùn.

906.en: This Tang poem is written very beautifully and touchingly.

907.en: The museum collects many ancient precious calligraphy and paintings.

911.en: Frequently staying up late will cause damage to health.

913.en: That huge ship is docked by the harbor.

915.py: Zhè shì yī běn kàn le hěn duō biàn de jiù shū.
915.en: This is an old book that has been read many times.

916.zh: 端午节我们全家人一起吃粽子。

916.en: Our whole family eats zongzi together on Dragon Boat Festival.

918.en: West Lake's scenery is very beautiful in all four seasons.

921.py: Chūn tiān lái le, tiān qì biàn nuǎn huo le.

922.en: My hometown is a beautiful small mountain village.

928.en: It is raining heavily outside, remember to take an umbrella when going out.

938.en: Wish you a pleasant journey and smooth work!

939.zh: 面对比赛，输赢都要保持好心态。
939.py: Miàn duì bǐ sài, shū yíng dōu yào bǎo chí hǎo xīn tài.
939.en: Facing matches, keep a good mindset whether winning or losing.

940.zh: 微风吹过，柳树的枝条轻轻摇摆。
940.py: Wēi fēng chuī guò, liǔ shù de zhī tiáo qīng qīng yáo bǎi.
940.en: The breeze blew past, willow branches swayed gently.

941.zh: 这家公司正在招聘新软件工程师。
941.py: Zhè jiā gōng sī zhèng zài zhāo pìn xīn ruǎn jiàn gōng chéng shī.
941.en: This company is recruiting new software engineers.

942.zh: 叔叔和阿姨明天举行结婚典礼。
942.py: Shū shū hé ā yí míng tiān jǔ xíng jié hūn diǎn lǐ.
942.en: Uncle and aunt are holding their wedding ceremony tomorrow.

943.zh: 进屋后请把厚外套脱下来吧。
943.py: Jìn wū hòu qǐng bǎ hòu wài tào tuō xià lái ba.
943.en: Please take off your thick coat after entering the room.

944.zh: 多吃新鲜水果能补充维生素。
944.py: Duō chī xīn xiān shuǐ guǒ néng bǔ chōng wéi shēng sù.
944.en: Eating more fresh fruits can supplement vitamins.

945.zh: 所谓熟能生巧，多加练习就能学会。
945.py: Suǒ wèi shú néng shēng qiǎo, duō jiā liàn xí jiù néng xué huì.
945.en: As the saying goes, practice makes perfect; practice more and you will learn.

946.zh: 老师督促大家按时完成每天的作业。
946.py: Lǎo shī dū cù dà jiā àn shí wán chéng měi tiān de zuò yè.
946.en: The teacher urged everyone to finish daily homework on time.

947.zh: 饭前认真洗手能有效消毒杀菌。
947.py: Fàn qián rèn zhēn xǐ shǒu néng yǒu xiào xiāo dú shā jūn.
947.en: Washing hands carefully before meals can effectively disinfect and kill germs.

948.zh: 做菜时少放油有利于身体健康。
948.py: Zuò cài shí shǎo fàng yóu yǒu lì yú shēn tǐ jiàn kāng.
948.en: Using less oil when cooking is beneficial to health.

949.zh: 在医生的治疗下，他的感冒好了。
949.py: Zài yī shēng de zhì liáo xià, tā de gǎn mào hǎo le.
949.en: Under the doctor's treatment, his cold got cured.

950.zh: 我和朋友打算今年夏天去北京旅游。
950.py: Wǒ hé péng yǒu dǎ suàn jīn nián xià tiān qù běi jīng lǚ yóu.
950.en: My friend and I plan to travel to Beijing this summer.

951.zh: 这块玉石在阳光下很有光泽。
951.py: Zhè kuài yù shí zài yáng guāng xià hěn yǒu guāng zé.
951.en: This jade stone has a lot of luster in the sunlight.

952.zh: 写作文前要准备好充足的材料。
952.py: Xiě zuò wén qián yào zhǔn bèi hǎo chōng zú de cái liào.
952.en: Prepare sufficient materials before writing a composition.

953.zh: 消防员迅速赶到现场把火扑灭了。
953.py: Xiāo fáng yuán xùn sù gǎn dào xiàn chǎng bǎ huǒ pū miè le.
953.en: Firefighters arrived at the scene quickly and put out the fire.

954.zh: 通过练习，他的听力水平正在逐步提高。
954.py: Tōng guò liàn xí, tā de tīng lì shuǐ píng zhèng zài zhú bù tí gāo.
954.en: Through practice, his listening comprehension is gradually improving.

955.zh: 莫等闲白了少年头，要珍惜时间。
955.py: Mò děng xián bái le shào nián tóu, yào zhēn xī shí jiān.
955.en: Do not idle away youth with regret, cherish time.

956.zh: 请借我一支铅笔写字，谢谢。
956.py: Qǐng jiè wǒ yī zhī qiān bǐ xiě zì, xiè xiè.
956.en: Please lend me a pencil to write, thank you.

957.zh: 亡羊补牢为时不晚，要吸取教训。
957.py: Wáng yáng bǔ láo wéi shí bù wǎn, yào xī qǔ jiào xùn.
957.en: It is never too late to mend the fold, learn the lesson.

958.zh: 超市里摆满了新鲜的水果和蔬菜。
958.py: Chāo shì lǐ bǎi mǎn le xīn xiān de shuǐ guǒ hé shū cài.
958.en: The supermarket is filled with fresh fruits and vegetables.

959.zh: 我今天在课上学了十个新生词。
959.py: Wǒ jīn tiān zài kè shàng xué le shí gè xīn shēng cí.
959.en: I learned ten new vocabulary words in class today.

960.zh: 孔子是中国古代著名的至圣先师。
960.py: Kǒng zi shì zhōng guó gǔ dài zhù míng de zhì shèng xiān shī.
960.en: Confucius is China's famous ancient supreme sage teacher.

961.zh: 在关键时刻我们要做出正确的选择。
961.py: Zài guān jiàn shí kè wǒ men yào zuò chū zhèng què de xuǎn zé.
961.en: At critical moments we must make the correct choice.

962.zh: 他在房间里仔细寻找丢失的钥匙。
962.py: Tā zài fáng jiān lǐ zǐ xì xún zhǎo diū shī de yào shi.
962.en: He searched carefully in the room for the lost keys.

963.zh: 爸爸在一家汽车制造厂上班。
963.py: Bà bà zài yī jiā qì chē zhì zào chǎng shàng bān.
963.en: Dad works at an automobile manufacturing factory.

964.zh: 晚上早点睡觉对身体健康很好。
964.py: Wǎn shàng zǎo diǎn shuì jiào duì shēn tǐ jiàn kāng hěn hǎo.
964.en: Going to sleep earlier at night is very good for health.

965.zh: 周末我们去参观了市历史博物馆。
965.py: Zhōu mò wǒ men qù cān guān le shì lì shǐ bó wù guǎn.
965.en: We visited the city history museum on the weekend.

966.zh: 清晨的晨雾勾勒出大山的轮廓。
966.py: Qīng chén de chén wù gōu lè chū dà shān de lún kuò.
966.en: The morning mist outlined the contours of the big mountains.

967.zh: 傍晚小村庄里升起了袅袅炊烟。
967.py: Bàng wǎn xiǎo cūn zhuāng lǐ shēng qǐ le niǎo niǎo chuī yān.
967.en: In the evening, wisps of cooking smoke rose in the small village.

968.zh: 李教授今天给我们讲授了一堂中文课。
968.py: Lǐ jiào shòu jīn tiān gěi wǒ men jiǎng shòu le yī táng zhōng wén kè.
968.en: Professor Li taught us a Chinese class today.

969.zh: 答应别人的事情一定要信守诺言。
969.py: Dā yìng bié rén de shì qíng yí dìng yào xìn shǒu nuò yán.
969.en: Things promised to others must be strictly kept to words.

970.zh: 伦敦是英国的一座历史著名名城。
970.py: Lún dūn shì yīng guó de yī zuò lì shǐ zhù míng míng chéng.
970.en: London is a famous historical city in the United Kingdom.

971.zh: 我们在风景优美的湖岸边散步聊天。
971.py: Wǒ men zài fēng jǐng yōu měi de hú àn biān sàn bù liáo tiān.
971.en: We walked and chatted by the scenic lake bank.

972.zh: 浩瀚的宇宙中藏着许多科学奥秘。
972.py: Hào hàn de yǔ zhòu zhōng cáng zhe xǔ duō kē xué ào mì.
972.en: Many scientific mysteries are hidden in the vast universe.

973.zh: 唐代是中国古代诗歌发展的鼎盛时期。
973.py: Táng dài shì zhōng guó gǔ dài shī gē fā zhǎn de dǐng shèng shí qī.
973.en: The Tang Dynasty was the heyday of ancient Chinese poetry development.

974.zh: 这家店卖的点心既好吃又便宜。
974.py: Zhè jiā diàn mài de diǎn xīn jì hǎo chī yòu pián yi.
974.en: Pastries sold by this shop are both delicious and cheap.

975.zh: 俄罗斯是世界上陆地面积最大的国家。
975.py: É luó sī shì shì jiè shàng lù dì miàn jī zuì dà de guó jiā.
975.en: Russia is the country with the largest land area in the world.

976.zh: 妈妈在厨房里炸了香喷喷的鸡翅。
976.py: Mā mā zài chú fáng lǐ zhà le xiāng pēn pēn de jī chì.
976.en: Mom fried delicious and fragrant chicken wings in the kitchen.

977.zh: 这辆货车满载着新鲜蔬菜运往超市。
977.py: Zhè liàng huò chē mǎn zài zhe xīn xiān shū cài yùn wǎng chāo shì.
977.en: This truck is fully loaded with fresh vegetables heading to the supermarket.

978.zh: 洛阳是一座著名的中国历史文化古都。
978.py: Luò yáng shì yī zuò zhù míng de zhōng guó lì shǐ wén huà gǔ dū.
978.en: Luoyang is a famous ancient capital of Chinese history and culture.

979.zh: 每天坚持跑步能让我们保持身体健康。
979.py: Měi tiān jiān chí pǎo bù néng ràng wǒ men bǎo chí shēn tǐ jiàn kāng.
979.en: Persisting in running every day can keep us healthy.

980.zh: 全校师生在大礼堂举行了开学典礼。
980.py: Quán xiào shī shēng zài dà lǐ táng jǔ xíng le kāi xué diǎn lǐ.
980.en: Teachers and students held the opening ceremony in the grand auditorium.

981.zh: 学校图书馆旁边有一棵很大的银杏树。
981.py: Xué xiào tú shū guǎn páng biān yǒu yī kē hěn dà de yín xìng shù.
981.en: There is a big ginkgo tree next to the school library.

982.zh: 北京故宫是世界上规模最大的古代皇宫。
982.py: Běi jīng gù gōng shì shì jiè shàng guī mó zuì dà de gǔ dài huáng gōng.
982.en: The Forbidden City in Beijing is the world's largest ancient imperial palace.

983.zh: 运动后喝一杯温开水对身体很有益。
983.py: Yùn dòng hòu hē yī bēi wēn kāi shuǐ duì shēn tǐ hěn yǒu yì.
983.en: Drinking a cup of warm water after exercise is very beneficial to the body.

984.zh: 我想去图书馆借两本关于历史的书。
984.py: Wǒ xiǎng qù tú shū guǎn jiè liǎng běn guān yú lì shǐ de shū.
984.en: I want to go to the library to borrow two books about history.

985.zh: 做人要光明磊落，做一个真正的君子。
985.py: Zuò rén yào guāng míng lěi luò, zuò yí gè zhēn zhèng de jūn zǐ.
985.en: In conduct be open and upright, being a true gentleman.

986.zh: 图书馆内严禁大声喧哗和吃零食。
986.py: Tú shū guǎn nèi yán jìn dà shēng xuān huá hé chī líng shí.
986.en: Loud noises and eating snacks are strictly forbidden in the library.

987.zh: 今天天气阴凉，微风吹着非常舒服。
987.py: Jīn tiān tiān qì yīn liáng, wēi fēng chuī zhe fēi cháng shū fú.
987.en: The weather today is cloudy and cool, very comfortable with a gentle breeze.

988.zh: 春天公园里的花园开满了五颜六色的花。
988.py: Chūn tiān gōng yuán lǐ de huā yuán kāi mǎn le wǔ yán liù sè de huā.
988.en: In spring, the garden in the park is full of colorful flowers.

989.zh: 做事要深思熟虑，提前谋划好方案。
989.py: Zuò shì yào shēn sī shú lǜ, tí qián móu huà hǎo fāng àn.
989.en: Think carefully when doing things, planning proposals ahead.

990.zh: 宋代是中国古代文学艺术繁荣的朝代。
990.py: Sòng dài shì zhōng guó gǔ dài wén xué yì shù fán róng de cháo dài.
990.en: The Song Dynasty was a prosperous dynasty of ancient Chinese literature and art.

991.zh: 大热天要多喝水，避免在烈日下暴晒。
991.py: Dà rè tiān yào duō hē shuǐ, bì miǎn zài liè rì xià pù shài.
991.en: Drink more water on hot days, avoiding exposure under scorching sun.

992.zh: 我们要抓紧时间，努力学习新知识。
992.py: Wǒ men yào zhuā jǐn shí jiān, nǔ lì xué xí xīn zhī shí.
992.en: We must seize the time and work hard to learn new knowledge.

993.zh: 他在比赛中夺得第一名，为班级赢得了荣誉。
993.py: Tā zài bǐ sài zhōng duó de dì yì míng, wèi bān jí yíng dé le róng yù.
993.en: He won first place in the competition, winning honor for the class.

994.zh: 姑姑从外地出差回来，给我带了礼物。
994.py: Gū gū cóng wài dì chū chāi huí lái, gěi wǒ dài le lǐ wù.
994.en: Aunt returned from a business trip and brought me a gift.

995.zh: 爷爷笑眯眯地看着可爱的小孙子玩耍。
995.py: Yé yé xiào mī mī dì kàn zhe kě ài de xiǎo sūn zi wán shuǎ.
995.en: Grandpa smiled watching his cute little grandson play.

996.zh: 遇到火灾时要用湿毛巾捂住口鼻迅速逃生。
996.py: Yù dào huǒ zāi shí yào yòng shī máo jīn wǔ zhù kǒu bí xùn sù táo shēng.
996.en: When encountering a fire, cover nose and mouth with wet towels to escape quickly.

997.zh: 每天早晚认真刷牙能保护牙齿健康。
997.py: Měi tiān zǎo wǎn rèn zhēn shuā yá néng bǎo hù yá chǐ jiàn kāng.
997.en: Brushing teeth carefully morning and evening can protect tooth health.

998.zh: 早晨一束金色的阳光照进了我的房间。
998.py: Zǎo chén yī shù jīn sè de yáng guāng zhào jìn le wǒ de fáng jiān.
998.en: In the morning, a beam of golden sunlight shone into my room.

999.zh: 听到这个好消息，他高兴得跳了起来。
999.py: Tīng dào zhè ge hǎo xiāo xī, tā gāo xìng dé tiào le qǐ lái.
999.en: Hearing this good news, he jumped up with joy.

1000.zh: 经过努力，我们终于登上了大山山顶。
1000.py: Jīng guò nǔ lì, wǒ men zhōng yú dēng shàng le dà shān shān dǐng.
1000.en: Through effort, we finally ascended the mountain peak.
